9750967af1446145.text: Manchester United have emerged as surprise contenders to sign wantaway Chelsea full-back Malo Gusto, according to talkSPORT. The Red Devils recently confirmed Michael Carrick’s dismissal as manager, and they are expected to appoint Mauricio Pochettino as his successor. Amid this, the transfer rumours are already underway and talkSPORT claim that Gusto is a player attracting […] Article written by Sri Aswin .
9750967af1446145.content: Manchester United have emerged as surprise contenders to sign wantaway Chelsea full-back Malo Gusto, according to talkSPORT . The Red Devils recently confirmed Michael Carrick’s dismissal as manager, and they are expected to appoint Mauricio Pochettino as his successor. Amid this, the transfer rumours are already underway and talkSPORT claim that Gusto is a player attracting interest from the Red Devils. Gusto has not started a league game for the Blues since September 12. He has found himself behind Josh Acheampong and Marco Palestra for the right-back position despite Reece James being on the sidelines. The Frenchman is keen on a new challenge elsewhere, and it is claimed that Chelsea would be prepared to sell him for around £75 million . United are mentioned as one of the prime suitors, though it is unclear whether they will approach this winter, given the change of head coach. Gusto to United talk could be agent-driven The former Lyon graduate has endured a tough season under new Blues manager Xabi Alonso and looks open to securing more consistent game time. Gusto has now been linked with United just days after their pursuit of Pochettino. That does not come as a surprise, given the Argentine first managed Gusto at Chelsea in 2023/24. The 23-year-old had an impressive debut season with the Blues back then as he contributed nine assists from 37 appearances across all competitions. Despite this, we simply don’t see United pursuing a specialist right-back who can occasionally operate in midfield or from the left-back position. United have the right-back slot well covered with Diogo Dalot, Noussair Mazraoui and Leny Yoro, and their concerns lie on the opposite end. With Luke Shaw’s injury woes, United ideally need a solid successor in the position, given Patrick Dorgu is attack-minded and defensively vulnerable. Shaw’s contract expires at the end of the season, and there is a possibility that he could be released on a free transfer instead of renewing his contract. Hence, the club are more likely to pursue a left-back. The speculation involving Gusto seems agent-driven rather than United initiating contact for him. United are also unlikely to spend a staggering £75m mid-season on a player who is unlikely to provide an upgrade on the existing options at right-back. However, in the space of five months, Carrick completely lost his grip on the reins, which ultimately cost him his job. Now that he is out, details from Carrington are reportedly emerging that partly explain why everything fell apart. Steve Holland was an unpopular figure at Manchester United According to club insider Sully , Steve Holland, Michael Carrick ‘s assistant coach at Manchester United, became disliked across the span of his Old Trafford tenure. 7d1e6b97e7c982ff.text: Manchester United have moved on to a new chapter after parting ways with Michael Carrick as manager. Mauricio Pochettino has emerged as the leading contender to replace the former United midfielder. The Red Devils would reportedly need to trigger a release clause worth around £7.5 million in his current contract with the United States national […] Article written by Sanidhya Bhardwaj .
7d1e6b97e7c982ff.content: Manchester United have moved on to a new chapter after parting ways with Michael Carrick as manager. Mauricio Pochettino has emerged as the leading contender to replace the former United midfielder. The Red Devils would reportedly need to trigger a release clause worth around £7.5 million in his current contract with the United States national team to secure his services. Former United captain Gary Neville is delighted by the prospect of finally seeing Pochettino take charge of his former club, having repeatedly called for the Argentine to be appointed. Neville said on Sky Sports : “I’ve always wanted Mauricio Pochettino as the manager at United. I’ve said it numerous times that I wanted him. “I think he’s a brilliant person. I think he’ll handle the media. I think he understands the size of the club. “But it’s a monumental task to win everybody else over and get everybody on side and make sure he has a team that can compete. “He’s a brilliant coach with great experience and he’s a good man. “He also believes in young players and bringing players through and developing them and coaching them, which is what he’s going to have to do at Manchester United. “I’ve always liked Mauricio Pochettino. Whether this is the right point for him to take the Manchester United job, who knows? We’ll find out in the next year or two.” Pochettino rose to prominence in England after his superb work at Southampton. His work on the south coast earned him a move to Tottenham Hotspur, where he transformed the club into serious title contenders and guided them to the UEFA Champions League final. However, despite building a competitive side and taking Spurs to the brink of European glory, the Argentine ultimately left without winning a major trophy. Pochettino arrives with considerably more managerial experience than Carrick, particularly when it comes to navigating the demands of the Premier League and competing in the Champions League. On paper, his appointment looks like the right decision. However, managing United is an entirely different challenge, as several serial winners have discovered to their cost over the past decade. Pochettino must establish his authority in the dressing room from day one, while also ensuring that the club’s hierarchy are fully aligned with his vision. 0b665151f100f11f.title: "Definitely kicked us on": Jess Park reveals exact moment Man United finally clicked under Eva Olid
0b665151f100f11f.text: Jess Park has pinpointed the exact moment that sparked Manchester United's incredible turnaround under Eva Olid after a tough start. The post “Definitely kicked us on”: Jess Park reveals exact moment Man United finally clicked under Eva Olid appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
0b665151f100f11f.content: Manchester United forward Jess Park has pinpointed the exact moment that sparked the team’s turnaround under Eva Olid. Tough start Olid arrived at United in the summer as a replacement for Marc Skinner, who parted ways with the club after an underwhelming 2025/26 season. She endured a difficult opening as United suffered a 2–1 loss to London City Lionesses followed by a 5–0 loss to Chelsea. The beginning of Olid’s tenure was marked by a thin squad, restricted pre-season preparation and delayed summer transfer activity. Manchester United Women 2026/27 record Stat Played 13 Wins 8 Draws 3 Losses 2 Goals For 33 Goals Against 16 Nevertheless, recent weeks have been far more encouraging, and United currently stand 11 matches unbeaten across all competitions. United have won four games and drawn two in the Women’s Super League. The Reds have also recorded four victories in the Subway Players Cup. Park spoke to club media and pinpointed September’s 1–1 draw with Arsenal as the moment that kicked off United’s campaign. A 96th-minute equaliser for the hosts denied United what looked like a certain victory. Park reveals turning point The 21-year-old said , “It definitely kicked us on. We showed what we were capable of in that game, and we showed that we could do it, and that we could have won that game. I think it could have gone both ways, but we got the draw out of it.” “We were really proud of that moment and we wanted to kick on from there.” She added, “There was a lot of change over the summer, and I think we were getting used to that, getting used to a new way of playing and understanding each other and how we want to play this year.” “It was obviously going to be a bit of a struggle at the start, but we knew we weren’t far off. It was just little things and I think we’ve taken it into our stride a bit more.” On United’s impressive run, she remarked, “We’re always focused on the result, whether it’s a win or a loss, and then we always focus on the next game. But this streak has been pretty incredible. We’re proud of it and we want to keep it going.” United are next in action this weekend when they face Crystal Palace at Leigh. She said of the upcoming contest, “They’ll bring a different game, and a different desire to want to beat a team that’s been here [in the top flight] for a while. I think we’ll face a different challenge against them, but we’re ready for it. We want to focus on our job and hopefully win the game.” United v Palace kicks off at 12.45pm. 2dfeb5ae87f5be30.content: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes has turned down a second contract offer from the club, The Athletic has confirmed. Uncertain future Fernandes’ United future is far from secure as his deal winds down. His current terms expire in the summer of 2027, although United retain the option of extending it by an additional 12 terms. However, as it stands, he will be free to speak to other clubs from January. It’s understood that United have been locked in talks for some time now with his representatives over fresh terms but a breakthrough has yet to be found. The Portugal international enjoyed a superb 2025/26 season as he helped United finish third and secure Champions League football after a two-year absence. He recorded 21 Premier League assists, breaking the longstanding Premier League record that was held jointly by Thierry Henry and Kevin De Bruyne. Fernandes claimed the FWA Footballer of the Year and PFA Player of the Year awards. These were in addition to winning the Sir Matt Busby Player of the Year prize. However, he has struggled to attain those heights this season as the Red Devils languish in the relegation zone. Apart from his hat-trick against Ipswich Town, Fernandes has not produced another memorable performance. Bruno Fernandes Stat Premier League UEFA Champions League League Cup All competitions Apps 9 4 1 14 Minutes 810 325 17 1152 Goals 4 2 0 6 Assists 2 0 0 2 United want to keep Fernandes but according to Laurie Whitwell and Adam Crafton of The Athletic , talks over a new contract have hit a stumbling block. Fernandes update The newspaper reports, “Bruno Fernandes has turned down a second contract offer from Manchester United.” “Talks over a new deal for Fernandes, United’s club captain, have been ongoing since the summer, when the first proposal was made and rejected by the Portuguese.” “United have more recently followed up with improved terms, but Fernandes is not yet satisfied, so further negotiations are anticipated.” “Salary and length of contract are aspects being discussed for the 32-year-old, whose current deal expires in June 2027.” It’s said that Fernandes’ declining form has not diminished his standing at Old Trafford, where he is still considered the team’s best player. The playmaker is weighing his future, having previously attracted strong interest from the Saudi Pro League and Galatasaray. dec27a67e2755061.content: It has been a disastrous start to the new season for Manchester United, who are 18th in the Premier League and have already exited the Carabao Cup at the first attempt. Damning results , coupled with dismal displays on the pitch and poor tactical calls , have meant former Michael Carrick has finally been shown the door. But it is not the former head coach who deserves all the blame. Key players have let him down on the pitch , while INEOS badly fumbled the ball in the summer. They signed three midfielders: Carlos Baleba, Youri Tielemans and Andrey Santos. All three have struggled so far. Carrick had recommended four names And none of them were the former United midfielder ‘s recommendations. Journalist Henry Winter reported that Carrick had asked the co-owners for four superstars in the summer. “Sir Jim Ratcliffe will one day have to explain why Manchester United didn’t follow Michael Carrick’s recommendation of the four players he felt the club needed in the summer window – Elliot Anderson, Lewis Hall, Morgan Rogers and, fourth on the list, Mateus Fernandes.” In midfield, he wanted the Red Devils to bring in Elliot Anderson and Mateus Fernandes. United were outbid in both cases , and INEOS panic-bought the Belgian and Brazilian , neither of whom fits United’s current needs. To end the over-reliance on Bruno Fernandes, who has struggled this season, Michael Carrick had asked the club to try and sign Morgan Rogers. He had worked with the Chelsea ace during his time at Middlesbrough, and he knew the England international could transform the team’s attack. Given Luke Shaw ‘s disastrous injury record, Carrick was adamant that a successor needed to be signed and he had recommended Lewis Hall. Andrey Santos v Carlos Baleba v Y. That forced Carrick to play Diogo Dalot out on the left, a ploy that has failed miserably . “Were debt repayments restricting their buying power? Was it simply because United felt the fees were too much for them? In the case of Fernandes, United certainly felt Spurs overpaid for the midfielder from relegated West Ham – £85m for a player West Ham bought from Southampton a year earlier for £38m. “Anderson went for £114m, Rogers for £115m. Hall (overlooked for World Cup) could probably have been got for £60m+ before he committed to Newcastle United. Anderson would have transformed United’s midfield – certainly more than the £150m spent on Andrey Santos, Carlos Baleba and Youri Tielemans.” It is hard to argue against any of the aforementioned points. Will Pochettino receive the necessary backing, or will it be a case of broken promises again in a year’s time? We will find out soon enough. After intervention from the Glazers , minority co-owner INEOS reportedly opted to recruit Mauricio Pochettino, who is relishing the prospect of taking over. The Argentine has a gargantuan task on his hands: from getting the squad fit and firing to making the underperforming stars play for the badge consistently. He arguably reached the peak of his powers last term, breaking […] The post Fabrizio Romano: Man Utd still trying to secure the signature of ‘greatly disappointed’ star appeared first on utdreport .
5cc62cf9de35e2a1.content: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes could be heading out the door by June, but the management has yet to give up on extending his contract. The 32-year-old has been the club’s most influential player since making the move from Sporting CP in January 2020. He arguably reached the peak of his powers last term, breaking the Premier League’s assist record per season and winning the league’s Best Player award. Fernandes has been struggling with some physical problems this season, which may have taken their toll on his performances, but he remains a vital player for the team. Man Utd won’t easily give up on Bruno Fernandes contract extension (Photo by Dan Istitene/Getty Images) With his contract expiring at the end of the season, Bruno’s future is anything but certain. In recent years, he was constantly tracked by Saudi Pro League clubs and other suitors, but always chose to renew his allegiance to Man Utd. But in the latest video posted on his official YouTube channel, Fabrizio Romano revealed that the Portuguese international has been ‘greatly disappointed’ with United’s ongoing campaign. The Red Devils have been abysmal since the start of the season, only registering a single win in 10 Premier League fixtures, so they now find themselves in the relegation zone. Romano thus confirms what was reported by The Athletic regarding Fernandes turning down a renewal offer from MUFC. Nevertheless, the Italian journalist insists that this won’t necessarily be the end of the road, as the two parties remain in discussions. Therefore, a solution could be found between now and the end of the season. Could Pochettino’s arrival spark a Bruno U-turn? (Photo by Chris Coduto/Getty Images) In recent weeks, Fernandes caused a stir by questioning Michael Carrick’s tactics in public following the 1-4 defeat in Como. A few days later, he was an unused substitute in the 0-3 loss to Bournemouth. So needless to say, Bruno’s rapport with the now-former MUFC head was far from ideal. Therefore, Mauricio Pochettino’s imminent arrival could spell a new beginning for the playmaker, and the entire club as well. In other words, if the club can start a positive run under the Argentine tactician, with the skipper hitting his best form again, then INEOS will find more suitable conditions to close the deal with the player and his entoruage. 996d89f3d9c32dd9.content: Manchester United have already announced the departure of manager Michael Carrick after a disappointing start to the new season. The Red Devils are languishing in 18th place in the Premier League after 10 games, with just one win to their name. Recent reports suggest INEOS have already reached an agreement with Mauricio Pochettino to take over at Old Trafford. The Argentine manager is currently in charge of the USMNT and is likely to arrive at the Theatre of Dreams at the end of the international break. Meanwhile, Carrick’s struggles have been baffling since he managed to secure third place in the league with the same set of players last season. Bruno Fernandes had been on fire under the English manager last campaign, managing four goals and 14 assists in 17 appearances. However, the Portuguese maestro has failed to replicate that form this campaign, which could be one of the reasons for United’s woes. United managed a coup by securing the services of Fernandes in January 2020. In hindsight, it proved to be one of the best decisions in the post-Sir Alex Ferguson era. A maverick genius who works tremendously hard on the pitch, the Portuguese is a manager’s dream, but one can argue that the Red Devils have wasted his best years. The 32-year-old has excelled under various managers at Old Trafford, flourishing in the No. 10 role but also operating in a deeper position as well as on the wings. Unfortunately, Carrick has not played to his strengths this season. However, the impending arrival of Pochettino and his high-intensity football could be good news for the United skipper. The Argentine must make Fernandes the centrepiece of his system at Old Trafford to revive the team. Pochettino must build his team around Fernandes Pochettino has always made attacking players a key component in his system. The Argentine achieved this with Dele Alli at Tottenham Hotspur and Cole Palmer at Chelsea, and there is no reason why he cannot do the same with Fernandes. Pochettino’s 4-2-3-1 system plays to the Portuguese’s strengths and can offer him enough freedom to express himself. Of course, Fernandes needs runners around him and the Red Devils have the ingredients for this role in Matheus Cunha, Bryan Mbeumo, Marcus Rashford and Amad. INEOS must secure able cover for Benjamin Sesko , who is currently injured, in January to further supplement the attack. However, Pochettino must also reduce Fernandes’ defensive burden, instead putting more responsibility on the two deep-lying midfielders in his system to shield the back line. The Portuguese must operate in the attacking-midfield role, in a tactical setup where his vision and creativity can hurt the opposition most. Fernandes is a natural fit in Pochettino’s system Fernandes is naturally a hard worker and does not shy away from his defensive responsibilities. This is evident from the fact that among United players, only Mbeumo has covered more distance than the Portuguese , who has played one game fewer, in the Premier League this season. Fernandes is often the one who initiates the press in the opposition half, and this makes him a fantastic fit in Pochettino’s system. However, the player’s tendency to lose the ball does represent a liability, but it is not something that cannot be fixed. The Argentine prefers attackers who can be decisive on the ball but also stifle the opposition once possession is lost. The creative players are expected to play a role in winning the ball back higher up the pitch. This is something Fernandes can be tasked with, given that he regularly tracks back and is willing to work without the ball. However, Pochettino must be careful not to make it the Portuguese’s primary responsibility and instead ensure he focuses on creating – and converting – chances. United must sort out Fernandes’ future as soon as possible Pochettino previously wanted to sign Fernandes at Tottenham Hotspur and will certainly be delighted to have him at his disposal at Old Trafford. However, the Portuguese’s contract expires next summer and recent reports suggest that he is yet to agree a new deal. United, as such, must do everything possible to convince their mercurial skipper to extend his stay at the Theatre of Dreams. The Red Devils are hoping that the Argentine manager can get the club out of troubled waters this season and lay the groundwork for a revival. Central to the English giants’ potential turnaround will be an inspired Fernandes performing at the limits of his capabilities. 9a65ba660dc69d75.content: It has so far been an absolutely huge week of news for Manchester United fans. Seismic week After weeks of speculation, Michael Carrick was finally sacked from his job as Manchester United head coach alongside his coaching staff. Argentine coach Mauricio Pochettino is now reportedly set to take over after Manchester United agreed a deal with US Soccer, while Pochettino has agreed a two-and-a-half-year deal at the club. An official announcement is expected soon, alongside confirmation of who his new staff will be. Player reaction Some players have already posted their reaction to Michael Carrick being sacked. Harry Maguire posted to his former boss on social media , “you will always be a legend. Respect. Thank you.” Patrick Dorgu also added, “thank you, coach and good luck for the future”, while youngsters Shea Lacey and Tyler Fletcher also passed on their best wishes. Bruno Fernandes reaction Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes waited until later in the day but finally sent his message to his former boss. He simply posted, “thanks for everything boss”. Nonetheless, this season has been more of a struggle but, even so, he has still managed to find the back of the net six times for his team and manager. What is more, Fernandes also criticised the coaching team after United’s 1–4 defeat to 1907 Como in the Champions League and was subsequently left out of the 0–3 loss to AFC Bournemouth just days later. Fernandes has also been in the news this week, as reports have suggested he has turned down a second contract offer from the Red Devils. 016d190343b93ffd.content: Manchester United have suffered a major blow in their bid to keep Bruno Fernandes beyond this season. Fernandes has entered the final year of his contract at Old Trafford and could walk out for free after June 2027. The Red Devils have the option to extend his stay by 12 months. According to journalist Danyal Khan , Bruno Fernandes has turned down a second contract extension offer from United. The club made their first proposal to the midfielder in the summer, when discussions over a new contract began. Salary and contract length are the key aspects of the discussions. Fernandes is free to speak to foreign clubs about a potential free transfer from January. The former Sporting CP star previously had a £56 million release clause in his contract, but that expired in July. The 32-year-old is the heartbeat of the current United side and his departure would be a massive blow. He etched his name into Premier League history by registering 21 assists last season, surpassing the previous record jointly held by Thierry Henry and Kevin De Bruyne. He won the prestigious PFA Players’ Player of the Year award and became the first United player to win the Sir Matt Busby Player of the Year award for a record-breaking fifth time. Fernandes is taking time to make up his mind after the club hierarchy made several promises that were never fulfilled. The Portuguese midfielder is an ambitious player and wants to win trophies at United. However, the lack of investment in the summer would have been a setback for him, just like it was for the majority of United supporters. INEOS are set to appoint their third permanent manager in 2026 after dismissing Michael Carrick yesterday. It is clear that the club still lacks direction, and Fernandes could be tempted to move elsewhere, where he would have a better opportunity to compete for major honours. f6f31fe03c9c90a3.text: Manchester United have finally parted ways with Michael Carrick, but only after infuriating his technical collaborators. The 45-year-old was initially appointed as interim coach in January following Ruben Amorim’s sacking, but the club eventually awarded him a permanent contract after leading the team to a third-place finish. Sadly for Carrick, what he managed to build […] The post Insider: Departing Man Utd trio livid with INEOS over Carrick sacking appeared first on utdreport .
f6f31fe03c9c90a3.content: Manchester United have finally parted ways with Michael Carrick, but only after infuriating his technical collaborators. The 45-year-old was initially appointed as interim coach in January following Ruben Amorim’s sacking, but the club eventually awarded him a permanent contract after leading the team to a third-place finish. Sadly for Carrick, what he managed to build last season swiftly collapsed. After a dismal run between August and November, INEOS decided to relieve him of his duties. Holland, Woodgate & Evans ‘very unhappy’ with Man Utd’s Carrick treatment (Photo by Dan Mullan/Getty Images) On Monday, almost every reliable source in the media reported Carrick’s imminent departure , as Mauricio Pochettino emerged as the ultimate candidate to replace him. The club’s CEO Omar Berrada and Director of Football Jason Wilcox made the recommendation, but they had to travel to Monaco for a meeting with co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe on Wednesday. The trio also had to bring Avram Glazer into the conversation to ratify the decision and green-light Pochettino’s expensive pursuit. This is the first time in Manchester United’s 148-year history that they have sacked two managers in the same calendar year (Amorim and Carrick). pic.twitter.com/428vu7NAV6 — utdreport (@utdreport) November 13, 2026 In the meantime, Carrick continued to oversee the team’s training . He conducted three sessions while fully aware of his imminent exit, before he finally received the news in person on Thursday morning. Fans and members of the media were disgusted by what they deemed an unnecessary delay, and apparently, so were Carrick’s technical collaborators. In his latest update on Round Table , reliable Carrington insider ‘Sully Talkz’ revealed that members of the departing coaching staff were very unhappy with how the hierarchy treated the 45-year-old manager. Assistant coach Steve Holland and technical collaborators Jonny Evans and Jonathan Woodgate have all followed Carrick to the exit door. What caused the whole Carrick fiasco? (Photo by Dan Istitene/Getty Images) Berrada and Wilcox have both had their shortcomings since joining Man Utd in 2024, but they aren’t necessarily bad human beings, as some are trying to depict them. The two officials seemingly intended to deliver Carrick the news in person out of respect for his great dedication and top professionalism, but when the news was leaked to the media, it caused an agonisingly awkward situation at Carrington. Needless to say, Carrick deserved better given how he refused to throw anyone under the bus, but managerial sackings are seldom pleasant business. d1e891f282dc6b10.title: Nicolò Tresoldi: Man United learn Club Brugge’s transfer stance in pursuit of red-hot striker
d1e891f282dc6b10.text: Club Brugge are reportedly unwilling to sell Nicolo Tresoldi in January despite Manchester United's interest in the German striker. The post Nicolò Tresoldi: Man United learn Club Brugge’s transfer stance in pursuit of red-hot striker appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
d1e891f282dc6b10.content: Manchester United have received bad news in their pursuit of a striker this winter. Struggles so far The Red Devils have been without a number nine for the majority of the season. Michael Carrick has also not trusted Joshua Zirkzee, despite the forward scoring two goals from the bench recently against 1907 Como and Aston Villa. This has meant that Bryan Mbeumo or Matheus Cunha have largely been asked to play out of position to accommodate this weakness in the side. Striker pursuit Therefore, it has been reported that United will pursue a striker this January to bolster their squad. With Mauricio Pochettino arriving as the new manager, it seems likely that the club will try to back him to an extent in the upcoming window. This is especially important with the club currently wallowing in 18th position in the league and in the relegation zone. Nicolo Tresoldi United have been linked with the German striker since the summer and were said to be competing with the likes of FC Barcelona and Chelsea for his signature. Nicolo Tresoldi Season stats 2026/2027 Competition Apps Minutes Starts Goals Assists Jupiler Pro League 11 865 10 8 1 UEFA Champions League 4 336 4 5 0 All competitions 15 1201 14 13 1 Tresoldi has gone from strength to strength this season, scoring numerous goals this season. Nonetheless, Belgian publication HLN has slammed the door in the face of any team wanting to buy the 22-year-old this winter. The paper reports, “the list of interested clubs keeps getting more impressive. Alongside AS Roma and Manchester United, names like Bayern Munich and Manchester City have now emerged—while even AC Milan, the club of Tresoldi’s dreams, is preparing a bid (which will ultimately prove futile).” It says that Club Brugge remain totally “relaxed” over interest in their star striker, as they “wouldn’t dream” of selling Tresoldi in the winter. The paper states, “should an official offer actually arrive at the offices at Alheembouw Basecamp, the response from the Bruges side will be firm and unequivocal: *Not for sale.* And that holds true even if the figure on the offer were to start with a 5.” When explaining the club’s rationale further, the paper states, “Club Brugge does not usually sell key players during the winter transfer window. The main reason for this is to achieve the set objectives with the squad that has been assembled for that purpose. The departure of a key player could create such an imbalance that, as is traditional, Club Brugge prefers not to take that risk.” Another reason they do not wish to sell their striker is that they believe players are often overpriced in January, so they do not want to spend money unnecessarily on a replacement. It is also reported that only an “astronomical” offer may test their resolve, with Club Brugge finding “itself in an absolutely enviable position. The club is financially sound and has no need for money, whilst fierce competition for the striker’s signature is on the horizon.” The Peoples Person Reliability Assessment Overall credibility: 8/10 Why? United have long-term interest in Tresoldi. HLN is considered a reliable source for Club Brugge news. It is logical that they will not want to lose their star striker in January. TPP view We believe that it is very probable United are keen on Tresoldi as a striker option, but that Club Brugge would only sell for an astronomical fee. 88b7e5af8347133e.text: As the dust settles on Michael Carrick's gutting exit, Gary Neville pulled no punches as he launched a scathing attack on Man United. The post “Quite simply disgusting”: Gary Neville rips Man United apart over classless Michael Carrick treatment appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
88b7e5af8347133e.content: Manchester United legend Gary Neville has slammed the club’s leadership group over their woeful handling of Manchester United manager Michael Carrick’s sacking. Dismissed On Thursday, United released a statement confirming they have parted ways with Carrick amidst the club’s dreadful form this season. United’s statement noted that Carrick is and will always be a legend but the worrying run of performances and results left them with little choice but to act. But United have come under intense criticism for how the process unfolded. While Sir Jim Ratcliffe and chiefs Omar Berrada and Jason Wilcox met in Monaco to sack him, Carrick was overseeing training at Carrington. He was still performing his duties at the time United were reportedly concluding a deal to hire Mauricio Pochettino as his successor. Manchester United’s 2026/27 record Date Competition H/A Opponent Score Result 08/11/2026 Premier League H Aston Villa 4-4 D 03/11/2026 UEFA Champions League H AS Roma 3-2 W 31/10/2026 Premier League A Chelsea 0-2 L 25/10/2026 Premier League H Bournemouth 0-3 L 21/10/2026 UEFA Champions League A Como 1-4 L 18/10/2026 Premier League A Leeds 1-1 D 13/10/2026 UEFA Champions League A Atletico Madrid 0-2 L 10/10/2026 Premier League H Tottenham 1-1 D 20/09/2026 Premier League A Fulham 1-1 D 16/09/2026 League Cup H Brighton 2-3 L 13/09/2026 Premier League H Manchester City 0-1 L 10/09/2026 UEFA Champions League H Sabah FA 4-0 W 06/09/2026 Premier League A Everton 2-2 D 30/08/2026 Premier League H Ipswich 5-2 W 22/08/2026 Premier League A Hull City 0-2 L Peter Schmeichel called out United’s “ disrespectful” treatment of Carrick , as did Norway head coach Ståle Solbakken, who directed the blame at Ratcliffe. Speaking to Sky Sports, Neville likewise pulled no punches in stating precisely what he thinks. Neville tears into United chiefs The former United captain said [as quoted by GOAL ], “I think after the Bournemouth game I said at the time that Manchester United effectively watched Michael Carrick resign on the pitch at the end of the game with that lap around, that wave goodbye.” “I think he was expecting it to come at that point and they were indecisive.” He continued, “They obviously felt that they might be able to get to the international break and there could be some sort of pick-up in results, but it’s been a difficult two weeks. Indecision, lack of authority, just basically really poor leadership.” “In the last 24-48 hours it’s been spectacularly bad to be in Monaco as an executive and an owner whilst your manager, who’s a club legend, is taking training on the pitch and simultaneously approaching the US Soccer Federation to approach Mauricio Pochettino.” “It’s just quite simply disgusting. That falls well below the standard of what you would expect in any other business, in any other industry. It would be constructive dismissal and you’d be getting sued.” “The optics of being in Monaco whilst the team, the staff, the people who are running the club on a day-to-day basis are in Manchester, it’s just not good and it reflects badly on the leadership. I don’t think anybody comes out of this well at all.” United are next in action on November 22 when they face Liverpool at Anfield. 48e97cd7ef00a6d8.title: ‘Stood no chance’: Belgian media react to Senne Lammens’ performance vs Turkey
48e97cd7ef00a6d8.text: Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens played the full 90 minutes during Belgium’s 2-1 Nations League win over Turkey on the road yesterday. The 24-year-old has endured a difficult start to the season with the Red Devils, and he recently made a couple of high-profile errors in the 4-4 Premier League draw against Aston Villa. However, […] Article written by Sri Aswin .
48e97cd7ef00a6d8.content: Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens played the full 90 minutes during Belgium’s 2-1 Nations League win over Turkey on the road yesterday. The 24-year-old has endured a difficult start to the season with the Red Devils, and he recently made a couple of high-profile errors in the 4-4 Premier League draw against Aston Villa. However, this has not necessarily hampered him for his country. Lammens was praised by the Belgian media during the last international break, and he continues to impress them. Lammens made six saves overall against Turkey last night. He was brilliant in a one-on-one with Baris Alper Yilmaz, though the forward was adjudged to be offside. The shot-stopper also played a part in the winning goal with a superb long ball and made two crucial saves at the death to ensure that Belgium picked up three points on the road. Shortly after the game, Belgian outlet Het Nieuwsblad ( page 19 ) were undoubtedly impressed by Lammens and gave him a 7/10 rating for his crucial contribution to the slender win. The outlet mentioned that Lammens ‘stood no chance’ against Guler’s curling shot but acknowledged he was brilliant thereafter, highlighting his late saves and long ball for the winner. They wrote: “Lammens stood no chance against Güler’s curling shot, but he looked strong in a one-on-one with Bar??—even though that play was ultimately flagged offside. He initiated the winning goal with a deep ball and made two crucial saves to keep the Belgians in the game during the final stages.” Lammens needs to replicate Belgium form at Man Utd Lammens has been unconvincing with his handling in the ongoing campaign for United. He has likewise been static against long shots and has shown a reluctance to dive when he could have. Such indecision has not happened with him on the international stage. Since replacing Thibaut Courtois in late September, Lammens has looked assured in goal without any major blunders. Lammens continues to remain United’s undisputed starter between the sticks, but he needs to step up his performances as the club seek to climb out of the relegation zone in the festive period. United are set for a new manager at the helm after Michael Carrick’s sacking. Mauricio Pochettino is the favourite and hopefully, Lammens can revive his confidence under the Argentine tactician. Belgium host Italy in their final Nations League group stage with a quarter-final spot on the line. They must beat the Azzurri to progress, particularly if France avoid a defeat against Turkey. Lammens is expected to start in goal for the Red Devils on Sunday. Stats from Sofascore.com Article written by Sri Aswin .

Pemain 24 tahun itu melakukan enam penyelamatan penting dan memberikan umpan panjang yang berujung pada gol kemenangan. Media Belgia Het Nieuwsblad memberi Lammens rating 7 dari 10 atas kontribusinya. Penampilan solid ini kontras dengan awal musimnya yang sulit di Old Trafford. Lammens kini bersiap menghadapi Italia bersama timnas Belgia akhir pekan ini.

The post Elliot Anderson was open to Man United move this summer but INEOS scuppered the deal appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
5c1f759d079455df.content: Manchester United invested over £150 million this summer to fill Casemiro’s boots, but it is safe to say that their midfield revamp has not gone according to plan. The Red Devils signed midfielders Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans and Carlos Baleba to complement Kobbie Mainoo in the middle of the park. Unfortunately, none of the players have lived up to expectations, with the English giants currently languishing in 18th place in the Premier League after 10 games. United have won just one game in the league this season and are already out of the EFL Cup. Michael Carrick’s attempt to switch from the counter-attacking football that paid dividends last season, to a more controlled approach this campaign arguably cost him his job this week. Recent reports suggest that the Englishman has been let down by INEOS in the transfer market, with the Red Devils failing to sign any of his four targets. 3a13c15ee97cfba6.title: Man United star’s shock career curse comes to light amid the impending arrival of Mauricio Pochettino
3a13c15ee97cfba6.text: Mauricio Pochettino will add to Matthijs de Ligt's surprise record if he takes charge at Manchester United as Michael Carrick's replacement. The post Mauricio Pochettino’s impending arrival at Man United will add to strange Matthijs de Ligt record appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
3a13c15ee97cfba6.content: Manchester United defender Matthijs de Ligt’s surprise managerial record has once again come to light following Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick’s dismissal. The Englishman was relieved of his duties this week following a dismal start to the new campaign. Having finished third in the Premier League last season under Carrick, the Red Devils are now 18th after 10 games this campaign. They have just one win in the league and three across 15 games in all competitions. United have struggled all over the pitch, but their inability to keep out goals has also been an issue. The English giants have managed just one clean sheet in all competitions, which came in the 4-0 win over Sabah in the Champions League in September. They have conceded 19 goals in the league and 30 across all competitions. Of course, there can be an argument that the Red Devils have missed one of their key defenders in De Ligt this season. De Ligt has struggled with injuries of late De Ligt arrived at Old Trafford from Bayern Munich in the summer of 2024 under the watch of former manager Erik ten Hag. The Dutch defender was signed as a possible replacement for Raphaël Varane, who left United at the end of the 2023/24 season. De Ligt has since managed 58 appearances in all competitions, registering three goals. He was particularly decisive for the Red Devils in the first half of the 2025/26 campaign, during which he was arguably the best defender in the league. Unfortunately, the 27-year-old aggravated a back issue in December last year and only recently returned to full fitness. In his absence, the English giants underwent another managerial upheaval, with Carrick replacing former head coach Ruben Amorim. With the Englishman now vacating his position and recent reports suggesting that Mauricio Pochettino is set to take charge, De Ligt’s managerial curse appears to be in full effect at the Theatre of Dreams. Matthijs de Ligt Stats: Last Season vs This Season Stat 2025/26 2026/27 Season 2025/26 2026/27 Apps 14 2 Minutes 1215 87 Starts 13 1 Sub appearances 1 1 Goals 1 0 Non-penalty goals 1 0 Assists 0 0 Goals + assists 1 0 Minutes per goal 1215 – Page 1 of 5 1 2 3 4 5 Stat 2025/26 2026/27 xG (PL) 1.38 – xA (PL) 0.83 – xG + xA (PL) 2.21 – Avg rating 6.95 6.33 Shots 9 0 Shots on target 3 0 Shot accuracy % 33.3% – Conversion % 11.1% – Passes 645 38 Accurate passes 565 34 Page 2 of 5 1 2 3 4 5 Stat 2025/26 2026/27 Pass accuracy % 87.6% 89.5% Key passes 3 0 Dribbles attempted 2 0 Dribbles completed 1 0 Dribble success % 50.0% – Tackles 19 0 Interceptions 15 1 Tackles + interceptions 34 1 Blocks 7 0 Duels 122 2 Page 3 of 5 1 2 3 4 5 Stat 2025/26 2026/27 Duels won 77 1 Duels won % 63.1% 50.0% Dribbled past 6 0 Fouls won 5 0 Fouls committed 6 0 Offsides 0 0 Yellow cards 0 0 Red cards 0 0 Penalties won 0 0 Penalties conceded 0 0 Page 4 of 5 1 2 3 4 5 Stat 2025/26 2026/27 Penalties scored 0 0 Penalties missed 0 0 Clean sheets 1 0 Page 5 of 5 1 2 3 4 5 De Ligt’s strange managerial record De Ligt has played under a new manager in every season in his career, and Pochettino’s impending arrival is set to add to that record. The Argentine is set to be the 12th different manager the Dutch defender has played under in 10 years. Surprisingly, he has never played under the same manager for two complete seasons! De Ligt broke into the senior side under Peter Bosz at Ajax in 2016, before Marcel Keizer replaced him in 2017. Erik ten Hag took charge in January 2018, and the Dutch defender forged a stellar partnership with him at the Johan Cruyff Stadium. In the summer of 2019, De Ligt left for Juventus, where he played under Maurizio Sarri before Andrea Pirlo was handed the job in 2020. The Bianconeri legend was removed from his position at the end of the 2020/21 season, with Massimiliano Allegri taking over in Turin in 2021. The following summer, De Ligt left the Serie A giants to move to Bayern Munich, where he started under Julian Nagelsmann before Thomas Tuchel took charge in March 2023. The Dutchman played under the German manager the following season before leaving in the summer of 2024 to be reunited with Erik ten Hag. De Ligt has already played under three managers at Old Trafford Unfortunately, former Ajax manager Erik ten Hag lost his job within a few months of De Ligt’s arrival, before Amorim took charge at Old Trafford in November 2024. The Portuguese was relieved of his duties in January 2026 in favour of Carrick . De Ligt made only two appearances under the English manager this season and is now preparing to welcome Pochettino. United fans will hope that the Argentine can finally break the Dutchman’s curse while also guiding the team back to the top. 07392dd3de127ca3.text: Manchester United had the opportunity to recruit Leon Goretzka on a free transfer, but chose to let it slip. The Red Devils revamped their midfield in the summer after parting ways with Casemiro and losing Manuel Ugarte to injury. They ended up buying Andrey Santos from Chelsea for £48 million, triggering Youri Tielemans’ £35 million […] The post The Athletic: Man Utd missed out on signing ‘role model’ on free transfer; He would have complemented Mainoo appeared first on utdreport .
07392dd3de127ca3.content: Manchester United had the opportunity to recruit Leon Goretzka on a free transfer, but chose to let it slip. The Red Devils revamped their midfield in the summer after parting ways with Casemiro and losing Manuel Ugarte to injury. They ended up buying Andrey Santos from Chelsea for £48 million, triggering Youri Tielemans’ £35 million release clause, and securing Brighton’s Carlos Baleba on a £70 million deal. However, these new acquisitions have yet to pay dividends, as the whole team has been in disarray since the start of the season, prompting Michael Carrick’s sacking on Thursday and Mauricio Pochettino’s imminent arrival. Man Utd considered signing Leon Goretzka in the summer (Photo by Julian Finney/Getty Images) In his latest article for The Athletic , Man Utd correspondent Laurie Whitwell explained how Carrick’s project swiftly collapsed. The journalist identified Casemiro’s exit as one of the main reasons behind the shocking slide from last season. The Brazilian was an important figure in the middle of the park, as well as an aerial threat on set pieces, so his departure left voids that went unfilled. Moreover, Whitwell insists that none of the three midfielders bought in the summer was at the top of the shortlist. Instead, Jason Wilcox and Co. were more interested in Elliot Anderson, Matheus Fernandes, Sandro Tonali, Aurelien Tchouameni, Alex Scott, and Ederson. GOAL! GORETZKA Manchester United 2-4 Aston Villa LEON GORETZKA MAKES IT FOUR! VILLA! are haunting United at Old Trafford! Premier League #ManchesterUnited #AstonVilla #MUNAVL #PremierLeague #LiveNow #Goretzka pic.twitter.com/YGecMI6z8R — Times Media (@Times_media1) November 8, 2026 While United’s interest in the aforementioned midfielders has been well documented, the source adds another name in Goretzka, who was available on a free transfer after ending an eight-year collaboration with Bayern Munich. The 31-year-old was another option INEOS seriously considered However, the Premier League giants were repelled by his age and wage demands, so they turned to other targets. Why Goretzka could have been useful for Man United (Photo by Pedro Salado/Getty Images) Ironically, the German international ended up replacing one of Man Utd’s summer recruits. Aston Villa signed the experienced midfielder to fill the gap caused by Tielemans’ departure. Both players were on target in Sunday’s fiery 4-4 draw at Old Trafford. Goretzka, who is considered a ‘role model’ for his exemplary professionalism, is a natural box-to-box midfielder who offers important contributions in both phases of the game. One could argue that he’s a profile Man Utd have been lacking, especially with Casemiro gone. In fact, he could have been an ideal teammate for Mainoo, who is gradually developing into a deep-lying midfielder and thus needs a dynamic profile alongside him. Baleba has been a rising force in the Premier League, but he’s been dealing with recurring injury problems, and even when fit, he’s considered more of a midfield enforcer than a box-to-box midfielder who can elegantly drive the ball forward like Goretzka. Finally, Santos’ role in the tactical setup remains unclear, as he has yet to excel in any area. Hence, perhaps INEOS would have been off saving the £48 million paid to Chelsea and instead betting on Goretzka, who was there for the taking. 7994ecf188303f03.title: Man United officially announce Mauricio Pochettino as new head coach after triggering £7.4m clause
7994ecf188303f03.text: Manchester United have officially confirmed Mauricio Pochettino as the new head coach of their men’s first team. United have reached an agreement with the US Soccer Federation, allowing Pochettino to take charge at Old Trafford from 18 November. The United States are scheduled to face Haiti in the CONCACAF Nations League quarter-finals during the current […] Article written by Sanidhya Bhardwaj .
7994ecf188303f03.content: Manchester United have officially confirmed Mauricio Pochettino as the new head coach of their men’s first team. United have reached an agreement with the US Soccer Federation, allowing Pochettino to take charge at Old Trafford from 18 November. The United States are scheduled to face Haiti in the CONCACAF Nations League quarter-finals during the current international break, meaning Pochettino will first complete his international commitments before beginning his new role. The Argentine’s first major test in the United dugout will be a blockbuster showdown against arch-rivals Liverpool. United have had to trigger the $10 million (£7.4 million) release clause in his current contract. INEOS could potentially have landed the Argentine without paying a release fee last summer, before he signed a contract extension with the United States. The Red Devils announced yesterday that Michael Carrick had been sacked after just four months in charge during the 2026-27 season. United currently sit 18th in the Premier League table after collecting their points from the opening 10 matches. Their season has also taken a disappointing turn in the Carabao Cup, where they suffered a shock 3-2 defeat against Brighton & Hove Albion to crash out of the competition. Pochettino arrives at Old Trafford with extensive Premier League experience, having previously managed Southampton, Tottenham Hotspur and Chelsea. He first made his mark in English football at Southampton before transforming Tottenham into a formidable side that reached the UEFA Champions League final. However, his subsequent spells at Chelsea and Paris Saint-Germain proved inconsistent, before he took charge of the United States national team. Article written by Sanidhya Bhardwaj .

3f9e31b33f4c7363.title: Carrick breaks silence for the first time as Man United announce Pochettino as new boss
3f9e31b33f4c7363.text: Michael Carrick thanks Manchester United supporters and reflects on the club's values after leaving his role as head coach. The post Carrick breaks silence for the first time as Man United announce Pochettino as new boss appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
3f9e31b33f4c7363.content: On Thursday, Manchester United parted ways with Michael Carrick as their head coach. The Red Devils had reportedly made up their minds on Monday, but Carrick was not formally informed of their decision and accordingly took training sessions at Carrington until Wednesday. On Friday afternoon, United announced the appointment of Mauricio Pochettino as their new head coach. Carrick, who remained a class act during this process, has broken his silence for the first time, stating on Instagram : “I’ve had the immense privilege of leading Manchester United, the football club that I love. “There are very few who get to live that and feel it, and for that I’m incredibly grateful. With that comes huge responsibility, and to be at Manchester United, you need to understand exactly what that means. It’s different to anywhere else. “Ultimately, you need to push to be the best, but there is a culture, there are values and there are behaviours that you have to live by and respect, which have been built over a long period of time.” He continued: “It’s a football club that is unique, with substance and history that cannot be ignored. This is what inspired me every single day. “I want to say a big thank you to the supporters. I must say, you are a special, rare breed. We’ve had some great times this year and moments we’ll all remember. The best thing about being in my position was seeing so many of you lose yourselves in the emotion of those moments, leaving the stadium desperate to come back again next time. “I just wanted to give you something back. That love never dies.” Featured image Alex Livesey via Getty Images online polls The post Carrick breaks silence for the first time as Man United announce Pochettino as new boss appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .

The post Man United have started transfer discussions for Martin Baturina, but they are not alone appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
ea31b5e825a830f1.content: Manchester United have struck an agreement to bring in Mauricio Pochettino as Michael Carrick’s replacement. Carrick lost his job on Thursday, after picking up just one win out of first 10 Premier League matches this term. There is no denying the Englishman could have done better, but at the same time, the club’s hierarchy left him in a difficult situation by not properly strengthening the squad. Manchester United have “started €80m transfer discussions” for Martin Baturina Mauricio Pochettino is reportedly expected to be backed in the January transfer window, when Manchester United are likely to be in the market for a defender and a striker. However, a report has now emerged suggesting United are also interested in signing a midfielder. According to The Daily Briefing , United have their eye on Como attacking midfielder Martin Baturina. It is claimed that United and Chelsea have “already started a dialogue over a potential €80m deal for one of Serie A’s most exciting talents.” The two clubs have reportedly communicated their desire to sign the Croatian sensation, dubbed the next Luka Modrić . The 23-year-old is a technically gifted midfielder known for his excellent link-up play and ferocious ball-striking ability. It is believed that a transfer could be “done” for €80m (£67m), with Baturina having “ambition to play at the highest level”. M. 6397dec1af9eed30.title: "No reason to doubt...": Belgian media send clear message to Man United after struggling ace's international display
6397dec1af9eed30.text: Manchester United's Senne Lammens impressed for Belgium against Turkey, making key saves and earning praise from the Belgian press after recent criticism. The post Senne Lammens hands Man United timely reminder as Belgian press hail “crucial” display against Turkey appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
6397dec1af9eed30.content: Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens has found himself under intense scrutiny in recent weeks. Senne Lammens’ stats Player Club Seasons Apps Minutes Clean sheets Goals conceded Senne Lammens Manchester United 2025/26 to 2026/27 47 4230 9 68 Senne Lammens Royal Antwerp FC 2023/24 to 2025/26 64 5747 12 86 Senne Lammens Young Reds 2023/24 2 180 0 3 Senne Lammens Club Bruges U19 2018/19 3 270 1 4 Source: Transfermarkt An erratic display in United’s chaotic 4-4 draw with Aston Villa saw supporters suddenly question Lammens ‘ credentials between the sticks. In fact, while the Red Devils’ leaky defence has been blamed for the defensive struggles, that Villa performance led fans to argue Lammens must bear his share of the blame for failing to pull off some saves he could have. Heading into the November international break, mounting social media noise even sparked calls for Belgium head coach Mark van Bommel to drop the shot-stopper in favour of Chelsea’s Mike Penders. | Silvio Proto tells Belgium manager to bench Seine Lammens for Mike Penders: “I’ve already said it. The most talented goalkeeper is Penders. Are we investing in the future or do we want immediate results?” pic.twitter.com/82hA6YF1Rg — Absolute Belgian Fans (@BelgianFans) November 10, 2026 However, Van Bommel refused to bow to public pressure, handing the United keeper the nod against Turkey, a decision Lammens duly repaid with a commanding performance. Although he failed to keep a clean sheet after conceding a stunning Arda Güler free kick, a strike few goalkeepers in world football could have stopped, Lammens bounced back with a standout display, pulling off six crucial saves to secure a 2-1 victory for Belgium. He also claimed three high balls, showing real authority in his box and dealing cleanly with every cross that came his way. Belgian media react His performance did not go unnoticed, and here is how the Belgian media responded. Nieuwsblad went on to write: “Helpless against Güler’s curling shot, but strong one-on-one with Baris, even though that phase was flagged. Set up the winning goal with a long ball and kept the Belgians in the game twice in the closing stages.” Footnews.be noted: “In the first leg, he managed to deflect an excellent free-kick from Güler, but this time, the Turkish star of Real Madrid gave him no chance to open the scoring (1-0), even if he perhaps could have taken a step further. He then dealt with the few shots on target from the Turkish side. In the final stages, Lammens even had to make two crucial saves to preserve the victory. Despite a more difficult period at club level, there is no reason to doubt his status as the provisional number one.” DHnet added: “He could do nothing about Güler’s free kick. He was attentive in other phases with firm catches and, above all, decisive saves at the end of the match.” A performance to build on Lammens desperately needed a display of this calibre. After a nightmare start to the campaign at Old Trafford, where he is still searching for his first clean sheet, this international boost should provide the exact shot of confidence he needs to turn his United career around. The post Rio Ferdinand fires demand after Man United’s ‘ChatGPT-like’ statement sacking Michael Carrick appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
0bfb42838e18e20e.content: Manchester United legend and former defender Rio Ferdinand has demanded a “face” come out to explain the club’s decision to sack Michael Carrick. Dismissed On Thursday, United released a statement confirming that Carrick had been relieved of his duties. Carrick’s time in charge ended following a disastrous 10-match winless run that left United in the relegation zone, where they will remain during the current international break. The legendary midfielder was handed the job on a permanent basis during the summer after an incredibly successful interim spell last term, in which he led United to a third-place finish and secured Champions League football after a two-year absence. But after a poor transfer window, United’s form declined dramatically this season, with the team picking up a meagre eight points from 10 top-flight games under Carrick . Michael Carrick’s Manchester United managerial record Stat Michael Carrick (caretaker) Michael Carrick From 21/11/2021 13/01/2026 To 02/12/2021 present Played 3 32 Won 2 15 Drawn 1 8 Lost 0 9 Win % 66.7% 46.9% Source: Wikipedia and API-Football Mauricio Pochettino, the Argentine coach, is the man picked to turn things around. Pochettino is set to sign a two-and-a-half-year deal to take charge of the Red Devils immediately. But he will remain at the helm of the United States men’s national team for the two upcoming CONCACAF Nations League quarter-final matches against Haiti. Only after this will he travel to Manchester. Rio Ferdinand was far from pleased with United’s announcement of Carrick’s sacking, branding it soulless. Ferdinand’s verdict The six-time Premier League winner said , “ChatGPT. Put it into ChatGPT and that’s what it spat out. It’s one of those generic, vanilla, clinical statements.” “That’s what I’ve been piping on about for two weeks. If and when this happens, such a situation comes, there needs to be a face to the statement.” He added, “All these statements that get thrown out… fans don’t even care. Don’t put the statement out, fans know it’s rubbish. Bit of AI has kicked it out, thanks very much. Do you mean it?” “If you have someone sitting and talking, it humanises the statement. You can put someone to it. That’s what we want and need in situations like this. This is an emotional time for anyone who loves the football club.” Featured image Gareth Copley via Getty Images online polls The post Rio Ferdinand fires demand after Man United’s ‘ChatGPT-like’ statement sacking Michael Carrick appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .

476169ce55364514.title: Luke Shaw & three other Man Utd stars who risk losing starting place under Pochettino
476169ce55364514.text: Manchester United have announced the appointment of Mauricio Pochettino as the new head coach, which will inevitably lead to changes in the starting lineup. After three woeful months, the management decided to take Michael Carrick out of his misery. Although the decision was made several days ago, the sacking was only confirmed on Thursday. On […] The post Luke Shaw & three other Man Utd stars who risk losing starting place under Pochettino appeared first on utdreport .
476169ce55364514.content: Manchester United have announced the appointment of Mauricio Pochettino as the new head coach, which will inevitably lead to changes in the starting lineup. After three woeful months, the management decided to take Michael Carrick out of his misery . Although the decision was made several days ago, the sacking was only confirmed on Thursday. On Friday, Pochettino was announced as the new head coach. INEOS opted to pay £7.4 million to release the Argentine from his USMNT contract, but he will still take charge of the next two games against Haiti before arriving in Manchester on November 18. What to expect from Man United under Mauricio Pochettino (Photo by Luke Hales/Getty Images) Although he’s still tactically rigid, Pochettino favours a 4-2-3-1 formation. Conveniently, this is the system Man Utd had long adopted, with its use only interrupted during Ruben Amorim’s 14-month reign. This is certainly good news for the players, who won’t be forced to adapt to a new formation in the middle of the campaign. But when announcing the 54-year-old, Man Utd included a key word in their statement, and it is high-intensity. “The Argentinian is renowned for his high-intensity, attacking style of football, his dedication to building strong, cohesive teams and his outstanding record of developing individual players,” reads the official note . This is an interesting conclusion given how United have been constantly bashed for their lack of intensity and pace under Carrick since the start of the season. Therefore, we can expect Pochettino to implement a new training regime in addition to a few tweaks in the line-up to accommodate the new approach. So which Man Utd players risk losing their starting places under the new head coach? Luke Shaw Luke Shaw (Photo by Molly Darlington/Getty Images) At the start of the season, Luke Shaw was considered the only natural left-back in the first team, so in theory, he should have a guaranteed starting role when fully fit. While that was certainly the case under Carrick, who deemed Patrick Dorgu more suited to a more advanced role, Pochettino has a knack for fielding an attacking-minded left-back, which will hamper Shaw’s chances, given how he can no longer trot up and down the flank as he used to. On the other hand, Dorgu is a young, hungry player who started his career at left-back and has the ability to drive the ball forward. Although he still has to work on improving his delivery as well as his defensive skills, the Argentine coach could be tempted to pick him. Harry Maguire (Photo by Carl Recine/Getty Images) After his revival under Amorim, Harry Maguire became almost indispensable at the back. While he remains a solid option, Pochettino tends to think long-term. Hence, fielding a veteran with an expiring contract at the expense of the young Leny Yoro and Ayden Heaven could contradict his beliefs, especially if Man Utd find themselves in a safe place in the Premier League table. Lisandro Martinez has had several terrible outings this season, but Poch is unlikely to completely alienate his compatriot, while the returning Matthijs de Ligt would be a welcome addition to the squad. Youri Tielemans (Photo by Molly Darlington/Getty Images) In fairness, one could argue that Youri Tielemans wasn’t supposed to be a regular starter under Carrick, but he was constantly in the lineup due to Kobbie Mainoo and Carlos Baleba’s injuries. Nevertheless, the English tactician seemed to be a big admirer of the Belgian, and one would imagine that Pochettino would also appreciate the midfielder’s composure and experience. That being said, Pochettino’s high-intensity approach means he’s unlikely to fancy Mainoo and Tielemans as his double pivot. It will be interesting to see what solution he’ll come up with in Baleba’s absence. Perhaps he’ll try to enhance Andrey Santos, who can be more dynamic than he has shown thus far, while Mason Mount will try to break into the lineup, albeit in a deeper role. Amad Diallo (Photo by Charles McQuillan/Getty Images) Many observers have been tipping Amad Diallo to thrive under Pochettino, and rightly so, as the 54-year-old could give the Ivorian the tactical freedom he desperately needs. But as we suggested earlier this week, Joshua Zirkzee could be the biggest beneficiary from the managerial change, turning from an ousted player to the striker who leads the charge. In this case, Bryan Mbeumo and Matheus Cunha will start as the favourites for the two wing roles. This won’t necessarily be a permanent hierarchy, but Amad would have to prove himself worthy of a starting role before he can start taking his career to the next level. The post Luke Shaw & three other Man Utd stars who risk losing starting place under Pochettino appeared first on utdreport .

4e6571002bddaf5b.text: Mauricio Pochettino breaks down in tears over USMNT exit after Man United appointment confirmed
4e6571002bddaf5b.content: US men’s national team head coach Mauricio Pochettino was in tears today as he addressed his final press conference before joining Manchester United. An emotional Mauricio Pochettino was reduced to tears during his final press conference as USA head coach ahead of his move to Manchester United pic.twitter.com/jtOEefvFF7 — Football on TNT Sports (@footballontnt) November 13, 2026 Pochettino set to replace Michael Carrick as head coach U.S. Soccer extended Pochettino’s contract through the 2030 World Cup on 3 August, securing the Argentine beyond the tournament staged in the United States, Mexico and Canada. United created a vacancy when they dismissed head coach Michael Carrick on 12 November. The Red Devils were 18th in the Premier League after winning three of their opening 15 matches across all competitions. Earlier today, the Old Trafford outfit confirmed that they had appointed the Argentine as Carrick’s replacement . Pochettino’s immediate schedule involves two Nations League fixtures against Haiti, giving him international responsibilities to complete before he can join United on the 18th. Pochettino sets next week as the time to address United Pochettino said: “We will have time next week to talk about the job in #mufc. Now it’s much better to talk about us and US men’s soccer. Now we have two games ahead and our focus is completely on this” (via The Athletic ). From Espanyol to the United States Pochettino played as a central defender for Newell’s Old Boys, Espanyol, Paris Saint-Germain and Bordeaux. He also won 20 caps for Argentina and appeared at the 2002 World Cup. His managerial career began with Espanyol in 2009. Southampton appointed him in January 2013, before Tottenham Hotspur brought him to north London from the Saints in May 2014. Pochettino led Tottenham to the 2019 Champions League final, where they lost to Liverpool. Spurs dismissed him in November that year following a disappointing sequence of domestic results. He subsequently managed Paris Saint-Germain, winning Ligue 1 and the Coupe de France. Chelsea employed him during the 2023/24 campaign, with the two parties mutually agreeing to separate in May 2024. U.S. Soccer appointed Pochettino in September 2024, and he went on to lead the national team into the 2026 World Cup on home soil. Final Thoughts United have announced Pochettino will join on 18th November. Pochettino was in tears at a USMNT presser, saying quitting was the hardest decision of his career. Pochettino has said he will discuss the United job next week. His current focus is on the US men’s national team’s next two matches. 744c6d0d8e23b0d1.title: Taking a brief minute to remember Pierre Sage’s impact at Crystal Palace
744c6d0d8e23b0d1.text: In today’s Football Daily: How only 83 words were needed to send Pierre Sage packing
744c6d0d8e23b0d1.content: GONE IN SOIXANTE SECONDS So farewell then, Pierre Sage. Many coaches leave under a cloud, not many have their departures completely obscured by the foul, retch-inducing one emanating from another team’s managerial circus, but such was Sage’s fate. The news section of Crystal Palace’s website helpfully tells you the amount of time it might take you to read each story it links through to. For example it should take four minutes or so to get through Tuesday’s “On this day: five big Crystal Palace birthdays”. “England: I love a knee slide!” will take you five. “Prize draw: be a mascot for our next [Bigger Vase] tie!” is a two-minute job. The statement informing the world of Sage’s exit? One minute. Eighty-three words. By way of illustration, the word “words” was the 84th of this paragraph. Just because the man’s French doesn’t mean his exit should be marked with a shrug. His supporters, such as they are, would argue he was hobbled by knack, suspensions and poor transfer dealings, and approximately nothing went to plan for the man who just six months ago was revelling in being named Ligue 1 coach of the year. His philosophy just never quite translated. “There are two types of teams: one with the ball, and the other chasing it,” he said last year. “I prefer to be the first of those.” And it is true that in Ligue 1 last season only Paris St-Germain and Marseille had, on average, more of the ball than his Lens side. But it turned out that Crystal Palace players were quite happy chasing it thank you, whichever of them he picked – and he picked most of them, fielding more players than any other club this season. They are averaging 43.2% possession, more than only Coventry and Hull. Against Tottenham at the end of October – when, to be fair, they were hobbled by a 13th-minute red card – they had the ball just 20.8% of the time – which, at least since 2013-14, they’ve never come close to equalling – and ended with an xG of 0.14 – not as bad as the 0.12 they registered against Manchester City in August 2022 (a game which, somehow, they ended with two goals), but worse than all their other ones. “It is,” Sage sighed after the Spurs match, “a disaster.” In that interview Sage said his “main principles” included “to look to get behind the opposition defence non-stop; and to press your opponents hard so you can win the ball back quickly,” Again, lovely ideas. But Sage’s Palace were absolutely rubbish at pressing – on Opta’s pressed sequences metric, measuring “the number of open-play sequences starting in their defensive third where the opposition has three or fewer passes and the sequence ends in their own half”, they are currently bottom of the league, and what high turnovers they have managed have led to just eight shots (second-bottom) and no goals (bottom). As for getting behind the opposition defence non-stop, Opta has recorded 24 through-balls this season, which actually is the fifth-highest total in the league. They have also recorded 23 offsides. Still, we should take a minute (but no more) to mark another coach’s departure. Farewell, Pierre, and good luck. You certainly had none of it over here. Others are far better placed to give tributes to the great man, but for younger generations who can’t comprehend the football cultural significance, Baker and Kelly represented the peak of football phone-ins. Before it became people ranting and raving about wanting the manager sacked as they’ve lost a few games or wanting the club to spend another few hundred million pounds on yet more players, it was about football supporters and supporting, from fans who actually went to games. Their peak was on BBC Radio in the 1990s, and there are too many examples of their greatness, but if I had to pick one, just one to illustrate it, it would, of course, be Gordon the Dundee United supporter and his bow tie. Rest in Peace, Danny Kelly. You gave us such joy” – Noble Francis. As they no longer seem to be ‘Dr Tottenham’, I was wondering if they had maybe passed the soubriquet on. However, the 54-year-old […] The post Just in: Pochettino dealt first Man Utd blow as projected starter suffers setback appeared first on utdreport .
979e5284465c4ae6.content: Incoming Manchester United head coach Mauricio Pochettino might not be able to rely on Patrick Dorgu, who has been sent back to Carrington. The Argentine tactician has been officially confirmed as Michael Carrick’s successor at Old Trafford, with the Premier League giants paying £7.4 million to release him from his USMNT contract . However, the 54-year-old won’t arrive at Carrington before November 18, as he will honour his current employers by overseeing their next two fixtures against Haiti. Denmark send unfit Patrick Dorgu back to Man United (Photo by Dan Mullan/Getty Images) Pochettino’s arrival in Manchester will coincide with the return of the bulk of the squad from the international break. But sadly for Dorgu, he’s set for a premature return to England after suffering a physical problem at the Danish national team’s camp. The wing-back had suffered a hamstring problem during the previous international break, which ruled him out for several weeks. The 22-year-old recently made his return to action and famously scored the last-gasp equaliser in Sunday’s dramatic 4-4 draw against Aston Villa. Dorgu udgår af truppen Patrick Dorgu har gennemgået en række test forud for kampene, men når desværre ikke at blive helt klar. #ForDanmark pic.twitter.com/JV5FQU5IiB — Fodboldlandsholdene (@dbulandshold) November 13, 2026 But while he was called up for international duty, Denmark’s doctor Morten Boesen deemed him not fully fit. “We have carried out a series of tests on Dorgu, and he has not performed well enough to be ready to play in the two matches,” said Boesen. “He needs further recovery time after his injury, so we are sending him home for additional rehabilitation.” Should Man Utd be worried about Dorgu’s early homecoming? (Photo by Charles McQuillan/Getty Images) At this stage, it remains unclear whether Dorgu has suffered a new problem during his latest appearance against Aston Villa, or if it’s simply a precautionary measure on Denmark’s part. If it’s the second case, it would raise serious questions regarding Man Utd’s medical staff, who allowed the player to take the pitch, whereas their Danish colleagues considered him unready. It should also be remembered that Portugal’s head coach Jorge Jesus revealed during the previous international break that Bruno Fernandes had been playing with a knock for several weeks. Therefore, United fans will be hoping for some clarification regarding Dorgu’s case. As for Pochettino, losing Dorgu would be a blow , given how many of us are expecting him to rely on the former Lecce star at left-back instead of Luke Shaw. It also remains unclear whether Shaw will be available after the international break, and the same goes for his compatriot, Marcus Rashford. 7e3998a436fdafed.title: The Athletic: Man Utd almost signed 'once-in-a-century talent' before opting for £35m transfer
7e3998a436fdafed.text: Manchester United came remarkably close to securing the services of a former Bayern Munich midfielder during the summer transfer window. The Red Devils recruited Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans and Carlos Baleba as part of an ambitious midfield overhaul aimed at strengthening the squad. According to The Athletic journalist Laurie Whitwell, United gave serious consideration to […] Article written by Sanidhya Bhardwaj .
7e3998a436fdafed.content: Manchester United came remarkably close to securing the services of a former Bayern Munich midfielder during the summer transfer window. The Red Devils recruited Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans and Carlos Baleba as part of an ambitious midfield overhaul aimed at strengthening the squad. According to The Athletic journalist Laurie Whitwell , United gave serious consideration to signing Leon Goretzka as a free agent instead of Tielemans. Goretzka was available without a transfer fee after bringing his eight-year spell at Bayern Munich to an end, although his substantial wage demands remained a major consideration. The German midfielder made 312 appearances for Bayern and earned 73 caps for his national team during an impressive career at the highest level. INEOS wanted PL experience At 31, Goretzka already boasts an outstanding trophy collection, including seven Bundesliga titles, and could have brought valuable experience to United’s midfield. His talent was once so highly regarded that Peter Neururer, his former coach at his hometown club Bochum, described him as a “ once-in-a-century talent “. However, INEOS remained committed to their recruitment policy of prioritising players with Premier League experience. United ultimately decided to trigger Tielemans’ £35 million release clause and bring the Belgian midfielder to Old Trafford. The 29-year-old has endured a mixed start to life at United, with his performances yet to convince everyone fully of his value. His lack of pace has occasionally exposed him in midfield, although his ability to pick incisive forward passes remains an important asset. Aston Villa were reportedly happy to let Tielemans leave and replace him with Goretzka, as they looked to add experience to an otherwise youthful squad. It is still too early to determine which club secured the better midfielder, but INEOS will be hoping Tielemans rises to the challenge and justifies their decision over the next six months.
