4c9b1486543c6ba5.content: Could Manchester United be considering adding another goalkeeping talent to their ranks, given the reports circulating this week? Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens has come under sharp criticism for his performances this season. His errors in the 4-4 draw with Aston Villa left some United supporters turning on him, arguing that while the defence has rightly taken much of the blame for the team’s struggles, poor goalkeeping has also contributed to the Red Devils’ undoing. Now, days later, United have been linked with a move for Brighton & Hove Albion goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen , with reports suggesting INEOS are eyeing him. But it is not just Verbruggen. According to 4-4-2 , Manchester United are among the sides to watch in the race for Robin Risser , 21, who was named Ligue 1 Goalkeeper of the Season for 2025-26. According to the outlet, RC Lens goalkeeper Risser is among Europe’s finest up-and-coming goalkeepers, having established himself as a commanding presence between the posts. Robin Risser Lens’ Ligue 1 stats 2025-26 Stat Lens Club Lens Pos G Age 21 Apps 33 Minutes 2970 Starts 33 Avg rating 7.08 Passes 869 Pass accuracy % 77.0% Key passes 2 Updated 13 Nov 2026 A modern, ball-playing sweeper-keeper, he is reportedly highly rated for his distribution and shot-stopping. His positioning and ability to come out on top in one-on-one situations have also reportedly drawn praise. Serious interest in Risser in England An unnamed Swiss outlet reports that Risser is attracting significant interest in England: “Manchester City, in particular, has Risser on their shortlist. The English club has been scouting the goalkeeper for some time and is preparing an offer of €30 million.” City do not, however, have a clear run at the young keeper: “Liverpool and Manchester United are also closely monitoring the goalkeeper.” View this post on Instagram Lens set their price Serie A interest has also reportedly emerged. 4-4-2 goes on to reveal: “The Ligue 1 club has already placed a price tag of €40 million on Risser. One reason for this is the fact that his former club, Racing Strasbourg, will receive 25 per cent of the transfer fee thanks to a sell-on clause.” United could turn their reported interest into a serious approach, potentially throwing a spanner in their local rivals’ plans. With Tom Heaton leaving and Karl Darlow likely dropping to third-choice status, Risser could arrive as competition for Lammens. The Peoples Person Reliability Assessment Overall credibility: 7/10 Why? Fits INEOS’ strategy of signing exciting young talents No other key source has corroborated the transfer links TPP view We believe Risser’s rise, powered by his quality performances, has thrust him into the limelight. It should therefore come as no surprise that United have reportedly taken an interest, just as City reportedly have. 58c794425023e7c5.content: Amid a managerial change at Manchester United, a major update has gone under the radar. Bruno Fernandes, United’s captain, has reportedly turned down a second contract offer from United, a move that suggests the Portuguese maestro is not entirely convinced by the Red Devils’ project. Fernandes’ current deal expires in June 2027, and, as things stand, he can talk to foreign clubs about a potential free transfer from January . Manchester United tracking Nico Paz According to The Sun , Manchester United have the option of an additional year on Bruno Fernandes’ deal, but his “dismal performance level and criticism of Carrick’s tactics have thrown his long-term future into doubt.” Accordingly, United are thought to be monitoring Como playmaker Nico Paz ahead of a potential move next summer. Paz, 22, joined the Serie A side from Real Madrid in 2024, with Los Blancos retaining a £67 million buy-back option on the Argentina international that can be activated next summer. The Como star thrives as a number 10, a position currently occupied by Jude Bellingham. Paz has developed tremendously under Cesc Fàbregas at Como and most recently scored a brace and claimed an assist in his side’s 4–1 win over United in the Champions League. It is believed United were interested in Paz before his man-of-the-match performance in October. Why Nico Paz could make a lot of sense for Manchester United United’s priority is reportedly to strengthen their backline and bring in a striker for Mauricio Pochettino in the next two transfer windows. bdfe590bb0aaba77.content: Manchester United players reportedly struggled to deal with Michael Carrick’s now-former assistant, Steve Holland. Both men were sacked on Thursday, alongside the rest of the first team’s coaching staff, with the exception of assistant goalkeeping coach Conor King. Man Utd directors’ hands were forced, as the team couldn’t carry on with this catastrophic form. With only one win in 10 Premier League fixtures, the Red Devils shockingly sit in the relegation zone. On Friday, United confirmed the appointment of Mauricio Pochettino, who will leave his post at the USMNT next week . Steve Holland grew widely unpopular among Man Utd players (Photo by Michael Regan/Getty Images) When Carrick was handed the reins in January, he brought in Jonathan Woodgate, his assistant at Middlesbrough, as well as his former MUFC teammate Jonny Evans. Moreover, Travis Binnion made the transition from Man Utd’s under-21 side. Nevertheless, this relatively young group needed a more experienced profile, so Carrick was paired with 56-year-old Holland. The Stockport native has more than 30 years of coaching on his resume, and served as the No.2 for former England boss Sir Gareth Southgate, in addition to a string of former Chelsea managers, including Jose Mourinho, Antonio Conte, and Roberto Di Matteo. But according to Carrington insider ‘Sully Talkz’ (via Round Table ), Holland became increasingly ‘unpopular’ among Man Utd players, with whom he’d constantly clashed. Holland’s Career Club / National Team Position Manager / Head Coach 1992–1998 Crewe Alexandra U18 Youth Team Manager — 1998–2007 Crewe Alexandra Academy Manager Dario Gradi 2007–2008 Crewe Alexandra First-Team Manager / Coach — 2009 Stoke City Academy Manager Tony Pulis 2009–2011 Chelsea Reserves Reserve Team Manager — 2011–2017 Chelsea Assistant First-Team Coach / Assistant Manager Villas-Boas, Di Matteo, Benítez, Mourinho, Hiddink, Conte 2013–2016 England U21 Assistant Manager Gareth Southgate 2016–2024 England Assistant Manager Gareth Southgate 2025 Yokohama F. Marinos Head Coach — 2026 Manchester United Assistant Manager Michael Carrick While he is renowned for his tactical knowledge, Holland tends to become a difficult character to deal with. Sources at the club have also described him as ‘extremely arrogant’. Moreover, Sully believes the 56-year-old was the main target of Bruno Fernandes’ famous post-Como rant , when the captain publicly questioned the team’s tactics. This detail was also reported by The Athletic journalist Laurie Whitwell. Holland reportedly returned the favour by convincing Carrick to drop the Portuguese playmaker for the game against Bournemouth, which United ultimately lost by three unanswered goals. Was choosing Holland Carrick’s undoing? (Photo by Dan Istitene/Getty Images) At the moment, it remains impossible to tell whether or not Holland was such a toxic presence in the locker room. The Amazon documentary will eventually shed some light on this particular front. However, the poor counsel around Carrick became increasingly evident as the weeks rolled on with the team failing to change approach or results, not to mention some of the perplexing in-game substitutions. All in all, Carrick was probably too green for the role, while Holland’s addition may have caused more harm than good. 1eaf3706aa8f703c.content: Manchester United midfielder Andrey Santos has endured a tough start to the new campaign since arriving at Old Trafford this summer. Signed as part of INEOS’ plans to strengthen the midfield, the Brazilian is yet to live up to expectations. Santos has made 10 appearances across competitions for the Red Devils this season, seven of which were starts, and he is yet to register a goal contribution. Former Manchester United manager Michael Carrick mostly preferred to pair Youri Tielemans with Kobbie Mainoo in midfield this season. With the Englishman vacating his position this week and Mauricio Pochettino taking his place , Santos’ fortunes at Old Trafford could take a positive turn. The Brazilian is currently with the national team, where he was asked about a myriad of topics, including incoming manager Pochettino. As such, the Brazilian did not actually work with Pochettino, and this will be the first time that he teams up with the manager. When asked about the pressures of representing both United and Brazil, Santos insisted that he likes working under pressure. He stated: “First of all, of course I really like pressure.” “As you know, I think if you want to achieve something and work hard, you have to live with pressure. I have a lot of pressure there [at Manchester United], and I have a lot of pressure here too.” World Cup dream Santos went on to open up on his World Cup dream, where he insisted that he has no hard feelings about being overlooked for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. He added: “Of course, I really wanted to play in a World Cup. It has always been my dream, my objective. I couldn’t be there in 2026, but now I have to work hard at my club to keep being here and think about the 2030 World Cup.” Santos also reiterated that he is comfortable carrying out both defensive and attacking roles in midfield, concluding: “Wherever the manager needs me, I’ll always do my best.” Only time will tell if the 22-year-old can become a key figure under Pochettino at Old Trafford. c5e61c97d26c1e07.text: Patrick Dorgu has been sent back to Manchester United to continue recovery from injury. In Manchester United’s last match before the November international break, Patrick ...
c5e61c97d26c1e07.content: Manchester United left-back Patrick Dorgu returned from injury in Manchester United’s 4–4 draw with Aston Villa, having been sidelined since the September international break. The Dane returned with a bang, playing a pivotal role as United salvaged a point. Patrick Dorgu stats Stat 2025/26 2024/25 2024/25 2021/22 Club Manchester United Manchester United US Lecce FC Nordsjaelland Reserves Season 2025/26 2024/25 2024/25 2021/22 Apps 28 20 23 3 Minutes 1580 1522 2000 34 Goals 4 0 3 0 Assists 4 1 1 0 Source: Transfermarkt · Updated 13 Nov 2026 His assist for Manchester United forward Joshua Zirkzee and his own strike in the dying minutes secured the 4–4 draw, denying Villa a 4–2 win. Just a day after his heroics against Villa, Dorgu , who was not initially expected to link up with Denmark, received a national-team call-up. He honoured the call-up, but in hindsight, it appears he should not have. Dorgu to miss Denmark’s Nations League fixture and return to Manchester United Providing an update on the Danish squad for their upcoming Nations League fixtures today, Danish outlet Fodboldlandsholdene reported: “Dorgu ruled out of the squad “Patrick Dorgu has undergone a series of tests ahead of the matches, but unfortunately will not be fully fit in time.” They quoted team doctor Morten Boesen, who stated: “We have carried out a series of tests on Dorgu, and he has not performed well enough to be ready to play in the two matches. He needs further recovery time after his injury, so we are sending him home for additional rehabilitation.” This update will raise serious concerns ahead of Man United’s clash with Liverpool when the Premier League resumes. Before Dorgu’s return, United’s left flank struggled significantly without a natural left-back. Luke Shaw hope While Dorgu’s return provided a major boost to the squad, the frustrating possibility now arises that he was rushed back too soon. On a positive note, however, Luke Shaw could be available for United’s visit to Anfield as the Mauricio Pochettino era kicks off. 54f556817382bc08.title: Man United ready to back Pochettino with two January signings
54f556817382bc08.text: Manchester United are likely to sign a striker and a defender in the January transfer window, according to The Telegraph. United have endured a poor start to the season, languishing in 18th place in the Premier League table. They have won just three games across all competitions. The Red Devils have sacked Michael Carrick and […] Article written by Henry Thornton .
54f556817382bc08.content: Manchester United are likely to sign a striker and a defender in the January transfer window, according to The Telegraph . United have endured a poor start to the season, languishing in 18th place in the Premier League table. They have won just three games across all competitions. The Red Devils have sacked Michael Carrick and have now announced Mauricio Pochettino as his replacement . The Telegraph now claim that Man United are ready to back Pochettino by signing a striker and a defender in the winter transfer window. United are likely to pursue a loan deal for a new centre-forward rather than make an outright purchase. Fulham’s Rodrigo Muniz and Real Sociedad’s Orri Oskarsson are two of the forwards linked with United in recent weeks. It remains to be seen whether either will be available in January. United have kept just one clean sheet across all competitions this season, which could force the club’s hierarchy to sign a defender in the next transfer window. They have reportedly shortlisted Everton’s Jarrad Branthwaite, Fulham’s Calvin Bassey, and Nathan Collins as potential defensive targets. Bassey could be the most viable option as he has entered the final 12 months of his contract, although Fulham has an option to extend for a further year. United currently have five centre-backs on their books, suggesting that they may need to sell one before bringing in another. They also need another left-back, but may not sign one until next summer. Man United must be prepared to back Pochettino in his first transfer window by strengthening both ends of the pitch if they are to stand a chance of finishing the season strongly. Article written by Henry Thornton .

44a84cf7a8a93147.title: INEOS confident of breakthrough in player talks that will shape the next few years - report
44a84cf7a8a93147.text: Manchester United remain confident Bruno Fernandes will sign a new deal despite rejecting the club's two opening contract offers. The post INEOS confident of breakthrough in talks with Bruno Fernandes after double contract rejection appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
44a84cf7a8a93147.content: Manchester United are set for yet another fresh start under a new manager who has been eyeing the Old Trafford hot seat ever since the great Sir Alex Ferguson called it quits. Mauricio Pochettino had initially underwhelmed INEOS, but they eventually agreed to appoint the Argentine after encouragement from the Glazers . The former Tottenham Hotspur boss has a gargantuan task on his hands, with the Red Devils currently in the relegation zone after 10 Premier League games. Most players are unfit, squad bonhomie is at an all-time low , and the squad is severely lacking in quality in certain areas. Pochettino’s first real test Yet, INEOS are still expecting European football at the end of the season , which is not the ideal condition in which to thrive. But the USMNT boss will have to deal with the hand he has been dealt, including convincing Bruno Fernandes to stay. The club captain has rejected both of United’s opening offers, and with his contract ending in 2027, déjà vu seems to be striking again. The Portuguese superstar was close to leaving under Ruben Amorim, before the current AC Milan boss convinced him to stay at Old Trafford. It must be remembered that the 20-time English league champions have the option of triggering a one-year extension clause in the attacking midfielder’s contract. INEOS’ stance on Bruno Fernandes That is the plan for now, with The Sun reporting that club officials are relaxed about the whole situation. They feel both parties will eventually reach a compromise and the 32-year-old will end up staying. “MANCHESTER UNITED still believe they can convince Bruno Fernandes to sign a new contract. Fernandes has rejected two offers from the club and is about to approach the final six months of his existing deal. A source who knows Fernandes well said: “We’ll get there.” United must convince Bruno Fernandes to stay “Club sources say United are relaxed about the situation and that it is common practice for players’ representatives to reject opening offers.” If United start strongly under Pochettino and INEOS display ambition in January, it will not be hard to convince Bruno Fernandes of the merits of staying. Despite a poor start to the season, the ex-Sporting CP ace remains the club’s best player and losing him would be a huge blow, something they cannot afford at this stage. 04039262a89c36aa.content: Former Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick reintegrated Marcus Rashford into the first-team over the summer. Rashford fell out with Ruben Amorim in December 2024 and was forced to leave his boyhood club. United tried to permanently sell him after his stints at Aston Villa and Barcelona. However, they did not receive a suitable offer and Rashford eventually reunited with Carrick. Mauricio Pochettino was “obsessed” with Marcus Rashford at PSG Marcus Rashford played a quiet role under Carrick, failing to register a goal or assist across all competitions this term. Furthermore, Rashford missed United’s past six games after a hip injury. However, he is reportedly hoping to be available for the Red Devils’ trip to Anfield to face Liverpool. His return will come under a different manager, with Mauricio Pochettino now at the helm, and the managerial change at Old Trafford may benefit the England international. According to Fabrizio Romano, Rashford is “not a normal player” for Pochettino. Speaking on his YouTube channel , Romano revealed that, when the Argentine was at Paris Saint-Germain, he was desperate to bring the United winger to the French capital. “Mauricio Pochettino, when he was Paris Saint-Germain manager, was trying in every way to sign Marcus Rashford. Pochettino was obsessed with Rashford,” the Italian journalist said. “He loves Rashford. Obviously Marcus had a difficult start to the season physically, in the sense that he had to deal with some struggles and so he was not in the best physical condition possible. 5dbee9eb9c3ecbf0.content: Manchester United’s much-hyped midfield revamp has not worked out so far, with Michael Carrick paying the ultimate price. It has since been reported that former head coach Michael Carrick did not want any of Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans or Carlos Baleba. However, INEOS reportedly forced the trio on him, and results have been on a steady downward trajectory ever since, with a lack of physicality and recovery pace a major concern in United’s engine room. The Athletic has revealed that both the Brazilian and Belgian were seventh and eighth choices at best, with the former head coach asking for vastly different names in the summer. INEOS failed to deliver in the summer “Carrick understood the financial limitations, but the midfield additions they did make were seventh or eighth on United’s list, when considering No. 1 was Elliot Anderson, followed by Mateus Fernandes, Sandro Tonali, Aurélien Tchouaméni, Alex Scott, Ederson and Ayyoub Bouaddi. “United signed Tielemans for £35m and he has been the only addition to feature regularly. Baleba’s hamstring injury sustained against Roma is set to keep him out for several weeks. Santos, 22, was on the periphery of Chelsea’s team last season, but United paid £50m for him.” Y. They preferred former Bayern Munich defensive midfielder Leon Goretzka, but eventually opted to trigger Youri Tielemans’ £35 million release clause. Youri Tielemans was not United’s first choice Incidentally, the German ended up moving to Villa Park and, while it has been a slow start to life in England, he did score against United at Old Trafford last week. “It can be revealed that United gave serious consideration to signing Leon Goretzka as a free agent instead of Tielemans. “Goretzka left Bayern Munich in June but commanded significant wages and will be 32 in February. 0fa6e91c3f6b85b6.content: Manchester United have added a stunning talent to their transfer shortlist. According to The Sun , Man United are monitoring Como playmaker Nico Paz ahead of a potential move next summer. Paz joined Como from Real Madrid in 2024, but the Spanish giants retain a £67 million buy-back option that they could activate next summer. The 22-year-old had the opportunity to return to the Bernabeu earlier this summer but opted to remain at Como, where he can continue developing under manager Cesc Fabregas. Nico Paz could replace Bruno Fernandes United may have identified a potential long-term successor to Bruno Fernandes, whose future at Old Trafford remains uncertain. It was recently reported that the United captain had rejected a second contract extension offer from the club. His current deal expires in June next year, meaning he will be free to negotiate with foreign clubs from January onwards. Fernandes has been the heartbeat of United since arriving from Sporting CP in January 2020, becoming one of the club’s most influential players. The Portuguese midfielder broke several records last season, although he has struggled to replicate those performances in the current campaign. With uncertainty surrounding his future, United must begin planning for life without their captain, and Paz could emerge as an exciting replacement. The young Argentine is primarily an attacking midfielder but also possesses the versatility to operate on the right wing. His attacking numbers have been particularly impressive, with six goals and eight assists in just 14 appearances this season. Paz is regarded as a phenomenal talent and has even been tipped as a potential heir to Lionel Messi in the Argentina national team. United have already announced Mauricio Pochettino as their new head coach , potentially giving them an additional advantage in the race for Paz. The Argentine connection could prove valuable in convincing the Como star to consider a move to Old Trafford. Stats from Fotmob.com Article written by Sanidhya Bhardwaj .

4b08498014666c15.text: Club Brugge have a firm stance on Manchester United target Nicolo Tresoldi for the winter transfer window, according to Belgian outlet HLN. The German has developed into one of the best young strikers, and he has had a tremendous start to the campaign with 14 goals across all competitions. United failed with an enquiry for […] Article written by Sri Aswin .
4b08498014666c15.content: Club Brugge have a firm stance on Manchester United target Nicolo Tresoldi for the winter transfer window, according to Belgian outlet HLN . The German has developed into one of the best young strikers, and he has had a tremendous start to the campaign with 14 goals across all competitions. United failed with an enquiry for the striker last summer, and it is claimed that the Red Devils continue to have a concrete interest alongside several clubs. Still, Brugge are unlikely to entertain a mid-season exit for the marksman. The Belgian champions have a policy of not selling key players in January as they believe in having a settled squad to achieve their season ambitions. The likes of Christos Tzolis, Ardon Jashari and Igor Thiago were only sold in the summer, and Brugge seem reluctant to risk the winter sale of Tresoldi. AC Milan in particular are already weighing up a winter move, but HLN insist that even £42 million won’t be enough to prise him away from Brugge in January. United need an experienced Premier League striker The Red Devils have had a lingering concern in the final third after Benjamin Sesko’s shin injury. The Slovenian suffered a recurrence of his setback from the back end of last season, and he is only expected to train from January . It may take several weeks thereafter to play regularly. Hence, United need to find a fresh solution at the turn of the year. Joshua Zirkzee has impressed with goals against Como and Aston Villa lately, but he lacks the physical presence upfront. Tresoldi is a fantastic upcoming striker, but the German may likewise struggle to find his feet without pre-season. On top of this, the former Hannover man may not be available for a transfer either. The best choice would be to land an experienced Premier League striker who can make an instant impact. Crystal Palace’s Jean-Philippe Mateta would be a good option with his contract expiring next summer. The Frenchman has netted 42 league goals in the last three campaigns, and would be a fabulous acquisition with his finishing skills as well as his aerial and physical presence in the box. He could be signed for a knockdown price with his contract expiring on June 30. The Red Devils could revisit their interest in landing Tresoldi next summer when Brugge are willing to negotiate. d7ad9857ebb1ba14.title: Jason Wilcox and Omar Berrada thought Michael Carrick could win Premier League this season - The Times
d7ad9857ebb1ba14.text: Manchester United's hierarchy privately believed Michael Carrick could mount a title challenge this season before a disastrous start led to his dismissal. The post Jason Wilcox and Omar Berrada thought Michael Carrick could win Premier League this season appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
d7ad9857ebb1ba14.content: Manchester United’s hierarchy are said to have believed former head coach Michael Carrick could launch a Premier League title challenge this season, only months before dismissing him with the club in the relegation zone. Carrick’s interim run transformed expectations Head coach Ruben Amorim left United on 5 January 2026, with caretaker manager Darren Fletcher briefly taking charge before Carrick was appointed until the end of the season on 13 January. Carrick won 11 of his first 16 matches and guided the Red Devils to third place, securing Champions League qualification. United rewarded him with a two-year contract on 22 May. Chief executive Omar Berrada subsequently said the club were in a good position to win the league within two years. That timetable aligned with “Project 150”, the plan to deliver Premier League titles for United’s men’s and women’s teams around the club’s 150th anniversary in 2028. The optimism unravelled rapidly . United collected eight points from their opening 10 league fixtures this season, winning only once, and dismissed Carrick on Thursday after a 4-4 draw with Aston Villa left them 18th. Ratcliffe shared extraordinary optimism behind the scenes The hierarchy, including co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe , were privately so optimistic about Carrick’s impact that they “thought a title tilt might even be on this season” (via The Times ). Changes to United’s data and recruitment departments also contributed to that confidence. Club officials believed the departure of Manchester City manager Pep Guardiola, alongside upheaval at Liverpool, Chelsea and Tottenham Hotspur, could create a favourable opportunity. Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox recommended that Ratcliffe appoint Carrick permanently after being impressed by his results and his ability to restore belief following Amorim’s turbulent spell. Carrick’s backroom team were viewed internally as a significant upgrade, while Amorim’s younger coaching staff, who had followed him from Portugal, were mocked around Carrington as “the kids”. From decorated midfielder to dismissed head coach Carrick joined United from Tottenham Hotspur in July 2006 in a deal worth up to £18.6 million. He made 464 appearances for the club, scoring 24 goals, before retiring from playing in 2018. His honours included five Premier League titles, the Champions League, Europa League, Club World Cup, FA Cup and two League Cups. Carrick moved directly on to United’s coaching staff and later oversaw three matches as caretaker manager in 2021. He left when interim manager Ralf Rangnick arrived, then managed Middlesbrough from October 2022 until June 2025, when he was sacked after missing the play-offs in successive seasons. With United 18th after one win in 10 league matches, head coach Mauricio Pochettino’s immediate priority will be to stabilise results and move the club out of the relegation zone rather than revive their title ambitions. The post Mauricio Pochettino planning imminent INEOS meeting to decide the fate of several key stars appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
bcc11e1fbfabdc72.content: Mauricio Pochettino has a monumental task at hand as he prepares to take charge of a beleaguered Manchester United. The Red Devils are currently in the Premier League’s relegation zone, having won one game all season, and have already exited the Carabao Cup. The Argentine is inheriting an unfit team with squad morale at an all-time low . With Liverpool up first, the current USMNT boss will need to get up to speed pretty quickly. As well as on the pitch, the former Tottenham Hotspur boss will also have to navigate contract matters off it. Quite a few of their high-profile names are reportedly on the verge of leaving, including Lisandro Martínez , Joshua Zirkzee, Luke Shaw, and even captain Bruno Fernandes . Contract talks planned According to Fabrizio Romano , Mauricio Pochettino has plans to sit down with the club’s hierarchy to discuss their futures. “Mauricio Pochettino will have specific meetings with the Manchester United directors to decide on some of the players who are already at the club. “What to do with them? There are some players who had planned to eventually leave Manchester United, for example, in the January transfer window, and having a conversation with Pochettino will help. The situation of Joshua Zirkzee is another interesting situation to follow. Pochettino will need to rebuild the squad in his own image “For Zirkzee, there was movement over the summer transfer window. Juventus, Fiorentina, Italian clubs, but also Everton in the final minutes of deadline day. Nothing happened. “Zirkzee ended up staying. And so now the opportunity is going to be for all these players to have a conversation with Pochettino and then decide on the future.” As previously relayed by The Peoples Person , one player the incoming head coach is eager to work with is Marcus Rashford , incidentally another player linked with an impending exit . It will be interesting to see if he can convince certain players to stay while offloading deadwood that has been allowed to fester over the years. 11f2c570a08c00e4.text: Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens has revealed that returning to the Belgium squad could help boost his confidence after a difficult start to the season. Lammens has kept just one clean sheet across all competitions, while United’s defensive struggles have also contributed to his difficult start to the campaign. He ranks 12th for goals prevented […] Article written by Henry Thornton .
11f2c570a08c00e4.content: Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens has revealed that returning to the Belgium squad could help boost his confidence after a difficult start to the season. Lammens has kept just one clean sheet across all competitions, while United’s defensive struggles have also contributed to his difficult start to the campaign. He ranks 12th for goals prevented and has made one error leading to a goal in the competition this term. The 24-year-old has turned his attention to international duty with Belgium. With Thibaut Courtois taking a break from international duty, Lammens was between the sticks as Belgium secured a 2-1 victory over Turkey . Speaking to Het Nieuwsblad , the 24-year-old acknowledged that returning to familiar surroundings could help him regain confidence following his recent struggles at Man United. “I always like to come to the national team. I’m coming home a little bit. I know all the players well and the system. It helps to boost self-confidence after difficult weeks at Manchester United. Lammens will be hoping to carry his improved confidence back to United and impress new head coach Mauricio Pochettino. The Belgian enjoyed an outstanding debut campaign with the Red Devils and was named the Premier League’s Transfer of the Season. Although he ranked 14 for save percentage, no goalkeeper prevented more goals than the former Royal Antwerp star. Pochettino’s tactical demands could pose another test for the young goalkeeper, with the Argentine known for an aggressive, high-intensity approach. Lammens will be expected to act as a sweeper should Pochettino adopt that system. His distribution will also need to be better. Pochettino will be hoping Lammens recovers his best form, which could help him hit the ground running at United. Article written by Henry Thornton .

43b2da6e29a3ec85.text: Senne Lammens says Manchester United's squad were behind Michael Carrick after INEOS dismissed the head coach following poor results. The post Senne Lammens opens up on Michael Carrick’s sack appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
43b2da6e29a3ec85.content: Michael Carrick paid the ultimate price for Manchester United’s dismal start to the season, with the Red Devils languishing in 18th position in the Premier League after winning only once so far. The former head coach received his marching orders amid complaints about the squad’s poor fitness levels and tactical blunders. INEOS’ role in this whole fiasco cannot be taken lightly, as they failed to back the Englishman in the summer. Add to this key players underperforming, and such a scenario was bound to happen. One of last season’s top performers , goalkeeper Senne Lammens, has struggled to replicate that form , with the Belgian failing to keep a single clean sheet in the league. Lammens on INEOS’ call to sack Carrick He arguably had the worst game of his United career so far against Aston Villa, in what turned out to be Carrick’s final game in charge. Senne Lammens 26/27 PL goals conceded Date Match 22/08/2026 v Hull City (A) 0-2 30/08/2026 v Ipswich (H) 5-2 06/09/2026 v Everton (A) 2-2 13/09/2026 v Manchester City (H) 0-1 20/09/2026 v Fulham (A) 1-1 10/10/2026 v Tottenham (H) 1-1 18/10/2026 v Leeds (A) 1-1 25/10/2026 v Bournemouth (H) 0-3 31/10/2026 v Chelsea (A) 0-2 08/11/2026 v Aston Villa (H) 4-4 The 24-year-old was asked about Carrick’s dismissal after his country’s international friendly against Türkiye. He explained that INEOS’ decision was a tough pill to swallow for the whole squad, which had shown through recent results that they were fully behind the former United midfielder. “Yes, these are difficult weeks. I’m not going to lie about that,” he admitted. “Of course, as a Manchester United team, we need to do better. Why United were forced to sack Carrick “Now the manager has been sacked. It’s obviously a difficult time, both for me and for the whole team. We were all behind him.” After the Bournemouth debacle, United’s co-owners had reportedly handed Carrick a three-game ultimatum . It started in disastrous fashion. The 20-time English league champions showed promise in the first half against Chelsea before Lisandro Martínez single-handedly dragged his team down. A trademark comeback in the Champions League against AS Roma followed, and despite a come-from-behind 4-4 draw against Aston Villa, INEOS decided to pull the plug. Mauricio Pochettino has a mountain to climb, with INEOS reportedly expecting European football at the end of the season despite the fact that the Argentine is inheriting a weak and broken squad . 46d8662c54e3ab34.title: Man Utd could make two signings in January including £42m Barcelona star - view
46d8662c54e3ab34.text: Manchester United recently decided to replace Michael Carrick with Mauricio Pochettino as their new manager. The Argentine is still in charge of the United States national team, but he will formally take charge next week. Pochettino has a tough assignment ahead as he aims to propel the club away from the Premier League drop zone. […] Article written by Sri Aswin .
46d8662c54e3ab34.content: Manchester United recently decided to replace Michael Carrick with Mauricio Pochettino as their new manager. The Argentine is still in charge of the United States national team, but he will formally take charge next week. Pochettino has a tough assignment ahead as he aims to propel the club away from the Premier League drop zone. Meanwhile, it has been reported that United could back Pochettino with a couple of signings at the turn of the year. A new striker and a defender could be pursued . We believe Jean-Philippe Mateta and Alejandro Balde could be targeted. Mateta has been long on the radar of the Red Devils, and the Frenchman has first-hand experience in the Premier League. He has netted 42 league goals for Crystal Palace during the last three seasons, but the current campaign has been disruptive. The 29-year-old striker was eager to leave the Eagles last summer, but a hamstring injury in August scuppered his chances. Mateta recently returned to league action for the south London club, only to pick up an unfortunate red card last month. It has been reported that Mateta would be open to joining United in January, with his contract expiring at the end of June. In our view, he would be a no-brainer signing for the club, given his track record. Mateta has the ability to get into brilliant scoring positions, and has also excelled with his hold-up play and aerial prowess. With Benjamin Sesko likely to be absent beyond January due to a shin issue, Mateta would provide a fantastic focal point in United’s attack. The striker almost joined AC Milan last winter for £30 million , only to fail a medical for a knee issue, which he has since fully recovered from. United should feel they can prise him away for just £10-15m this winter. He would be a low-risk signing, given his rich league experience. Alongside him, a new left-back appears a necessity, given Luke Shaw’s injury record and Patrick Dorgu’s defensive vulnerabilities. Dorgu showed his class in an attacking capacity against Aston Villa. He bagged a goal and an assist on his return from injury as a substitute. However, the Dane is not the best in his positioning at the back and fares better as a winger. Hence, there is definite room for a marquee left-back. We believe United should seek a loan move for Barcelona’s Alejandro Balde to assess whether the Spaniard can adapt to the Premier League. The left-back was under United’s consideration last summer, but he chose to fight for his spot under Barcelona manager Hansi Flick. However, the decision has not proved worthwhile for him, with just 124 minutes across five appearances for the Catalan giants thus far. Balde has had just one start against Real Madrid. Barcelona recently suffered a big setback with Xavi Espart out with injury until late December, but Balde has still found himself out of contention. Joao Cancelo has played at left-back, while Flick has gone with 20-year-old Brian Farinas at right-back, with Jules Kounde nursing an injury too. Hence, we won’t be surprised if Balde opens the door for a move in January, having resisted the prospect during the summer transfer window. Sport previously said that Balde could be signed for £42 million , but United may need to tread carefully, given the left-back’s injury record. The club should initially assess whether the Spaniard can cope with the league’s intensity and physicality before committing to a permanent deal. We feel United should propose a short-term loan with an option to buy next summer. Stats from Transfermarkt.com Article written by Sri Aswin .

d2f676812328e61c.content: Alan Shearer has slammed Manchester United’s treatment of Michael Carrick as an ‘absolute disgrace’. The head coach was officially relieved of his duties on Thursday, despite reports suggesting since the beginning of the week that he would be let go. How Carrick’s sacking played out (Photo by Dan Mullan/Getty Images) Remarkably, he took the side’s training sessions each day at Carrington, while club chiefs Omar Berrada and Jason Wilcox flew to Monaco to meet with Jim Ratcliffe to discuss Carrick’s imminent sacking. Michael Carrick was seen leaving Man Utd's training ground this morning after being sacked. pic.twitter.com/zVWIfSt5gF — Match of the Day (@BBCMOTD) November 12, 2026 They were simultaneously holding talks with Mauricio Pochettino to gauge whether he’d be interested in taking the job, and had a deal agreed in principle by Wednesday. All that was left to do was bid farewell to Carrick and activate Pochettino’s £7 million release clause with the United States, before the club announced his impending arrival on Friday. The Argentine will, however, oversee the USMNT’s Concacaf Nations League double-header against Haiti, with the second fixture taking place next Wednesday. What Shearer had to say (Photo by Dan Istitene/Getty Images) One thing that has seemingly united fans, ex-players and pundits is the belief that United’s board have acted atrociously towards a club legend. Alan Shearer reacted on The Rest Is Football: “I don’t think you’re going to have any complaints (over Carrick’s exit) because of the results. “You know when you’re a coach or a manager, if you don’t win games, ultimately you’re going to get sacked. But I think it is an absolute disgrace how it unfolded. “How he (Carrick) had to read about it every single day for the last 10 days about who they (INEOS) were going to meet, where they’re going to meet them, who they’re going to appoint.” “I just think it was so lacking in class,” Shearer continued. “So unprofessional, and it should not have happened and been played out that way for anyone, let alone anyone who had represented United as well as Carrick has done over the years.” The post ‘An absolute disgrace’: Shearer in disbelief at news he’s heard out of Man United this week, fans will agree appeared first on utdreport .

2bcf6306bb9b3d58.content: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez played the entire 90 minutes during Argentina’s 2-1 friendly defeat to Uruguay in Buenos Aires. The 28-year-old has had a tough season with the Red Devils, and he has already been responsible for five defensive errors that have directly led to goals. Martinez was recently suspended for the 4-4 Premier League draw against Aston Villa at Old Trafford after a needless sending-off against Chelsea this month. He is expected to return to the starting XI when the league season resumes, but he had another mixed outing for Argentina in their 2-1 defeat to Uruguay yesterday. Martinez was paired alongside Leonardo Balerdi in the heart of Argentina’s backline. He did not make any glaring errors but looked unconvincing in the lead-up to Uruguay’s opener. Shortly after the game, popular Argentine outlet TyC Sports said that Martinez is ‘not enjoying’ his best form at United, and it showed in his chemistry with Balerdi on the pitch. The publication added that Martinez had to be overly alert due to Balerdi’s poor positioning. He was eventually handed a 5/10 rating; only Balerdi and Thiago Almada got less. TyC Sports wrote: “He’s not enjoying his best form at United, and it showed somewhat in his confidence and understanding with his centre-back partner. “While he didn’t make any major errors, his involvement in Uruguay’s first goal wasn’t his best and didn’t live up to his other excellent performances. “He had to be overly alert in his tackles due to Balerdi’s poor positioning.” Martinez has big point to prove after international break The former Ajax man was hugely critical of the recruitment earlier last month. He publicly criticised sporting director Jason Wilcox after the 2-0 Champions League loss at Atletico Madrid. Martinez openly said that the current recruitment is not sufficient and the club need a better squad to compete for silverware. However, he has since let down the team with his red card at Chelsea. The World Cup winner has likewise made several defensive errors leading to goals, and he needs to step up big time and prove that he is worthy of a starting spot at United going forward. Martinez should be reinstated alongside Harry Maguire in central defence when the season resumes and the onus is on him to prove his point with top performances in the festive period. Otherwise, United could start looking into the future. His current contract expires in June next year, but there is an option to extend for another 12 months that has not been triggered yet. United seem prepared to back new manager Mauricio Pochettino with a couple of signings in January. A defender could be pursued and it may end up as a left centre-back if Martinez continues to struggle. Stats from Transfermarkt.com & Sofascore.com Article written by Sri Aswin .

abd96fb72ab44404.text: Following Mauricio Pochettino's arrival, Manchester United now have the groundwork for a future pursuit of Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane. The post Harry Kane: Man United have perfect opportunity to sign Englishman after Mauricio Pochettino arrival appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
abd96fb72ab44404.content: Manchester United’s pursuit of Harry Kane ended in a whimper after he signed a new deal with Bayern Munich last week. The English striker’s previous contract was due to expire at the end of this season, adding to speculation regarding his future and fuelling talks of a possible return to the Premier League. However, Kane has since poured cold water on those rumours by committing himself to the Bundesliga champions until 2029. That may have effectively ended all chances of a move to Old Trafford in January or even next summer. The English giants are in desperate need of a proven No. 9 in their squad, and Kane would have been perfect for the job. United’s striker woes United have been home to some legendary strikers in the past but have struggled to fill the position ever since Robin van Persie left. There have been moments of optimism with Zlatan Ibrahimovic, Romelu Lukaku, and Edinson Cavani, but the Red Devils have mostly faltered with their striker signings in the post-Sir Alex Ferguson era. The English giants did have the opportunity to sign Kane in 2023, before his move to the Allianz Arena, but ended up securing Rasmus Højlund instead. Joshua Zirkzee and Benjamin Šeško have followed the Dane to Old Trafford, and neither have managed to impress. This season, the Slovenian has registered just two goals in six games and remains sidelined until at least January. Zirkzee was not rated by Michael Carrick and has done little of note either. United are 18th in the Premier League table after 10 games, and Carrick has already been replaced by Mauricio Pochettino this week. The Argentine is expected to mount an immediate turnaround while also building a team that can challenge for trophies soon. Pochettino’s arrival , meanwhile, could also put United in a strong position to eventually secure a long-term target – Kane. Pochettino will be eyeing Kane reunion Kane exploded onto the scene under Pochettino at Tottenham Hotspur and would go on to register 169 goals in 242 appearances during their time together. The Argentine knows exactly how to set his team up to get the best out of the sizzling striker, so his presence at Old Trafford will certainly be an alluring factor. Kane, however, has also been on a goalscoring spree under Vincent Kompany at the Allianz Arena, managing 112 goals in 117 appearances. As such, even though Pochettino could be keen to rekindle his partnership with the English striker, the Argentine’s presence alone may not suffice. He will have to build a team that can fight for trophies and perhaps even win one before he can tempt Kane into a reunion. Bayern are constantly challenging for silverware, and United would have to show the Englishman that they can be on a par with the German giants to convince him to move. That, however, could also work as motivation for a club which has struggled to get going for some time. Success will draw better players, and there are few better than the 2026 Ballon d’Or winner. While the former Tottenham Hotspur striker has downplayed any desire to claim that feat, it is hard to imagine that a potent goalscorer like him will not be dreaming of it. This is another situation that United must use to their benefit. While an immediate move may not be possible due to his contract situation, the Red Devils must be ready to act if the opportunity presents itself. Kane will not be short of suitors in the Premier League, but Tottenham Hotspur are likely to be United’s only real competitor. A move to Arsenal is out of the question due to the north London rivalry, and the Englishman is unlikely to join another London club, Chelsea. Liverpool just spent a small fortune on Alexander Isak, while Manchester City already have Erling Haaland and are battling 115 charges. While a fairytale return to Tottenham Hotspur could be on the cards, the Red Devils are likely to be a more enticing destination, even with their recent struggles. Kane now better suited for Old Trafford There is an argument that United missed a trick by not going all-out for Kane in the summer of 2023. He would have cost an exorbitant transfer fee, yes, but he could have sorted out the No. 9 role for years. Although that has not materialised, a move for the Englishman next summer or even in 2028 could still be a masterstroke. Kane has aged like fine wine with Bayern Munich, scoring 156 goals and registering 43 assists in 162 appearances. He has gained invaluable trophy-winning experience and is arguably a wiser striker now than he was with Tottenham Hotspur. The Red Devils, as such, must prepare the groundwork for a possible move in 2027. It will neither be easy

ebebaed2c6c09d7e.title: Mauricio Pochettino: Why Man United have finally found the right man at the right time - opinion
ebebaed2c6c09d7e.text: Mauricio Pochettino could be the right manager at the right time to develop Manchester United's young squad and restore consistency. The post Mauricio Pochettino: Why Man United have finally found the right man at the right time appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
ebebaed2c6c09d7e.content: Manchester United have once again taken the decision to hire a new manager. With the club wallowing in 18th position in the league with just one victory in 10 league matches, it is perhaps not hard to see why. Since the retirement of Sir Alex Ferguson in 2013, David Moyes, Louis van Gaal, Jose Mourinho, Ole Gunnar Solskjaer, Erik ten Hag, Ruben Amorim and Michael Carrick have all been given the job permanently and all have failed to live up to the club’s huge expectations. Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino has now become the eighth man to try his luck. Poor timing United have clearly hired some talented managers from around the world, including some of the more famous names, but it has never quite worked out for the club. Many feel that Mourinho had the stature to be United boss, but he should have joined in 2013 when he was still at the peak of his powers and the Red Devils had a collection of veteran winners who had won numerous titles. Louis van Gaal was also a Champions League-winning coach who had managed huge clubs such as FC Barcelona and Ajax, but by 2014 was once again nowhere near the zenith of his career. Solskjaer and Carrick both did fine jobs as interim managers, but once they were made permanent, their form and playing style would eventually crumble, even if Solskjaer managed to impress for much longer than Carrick. David Moyes, Erik ten Hag and Ruben Amorim also all had success at different clubs, but once again, they probably arrived at an inopportune time. Ironically, Moyes would have been suited to later United squads, which lacked as many big personalities and had younger players who had not yet achieved such standing in the game. Amorim would probably have also benefited from being hired in the summer so he could have had more time to implement his back-five system rather than trying to adapt on the fly in the middle of a packed winter schedule. Finally, right time, right place Pochettino might just finally be the right man at the right time for United. The Argentine is known as a manager who can improve players. This can be seen in the work he did with the likes of Harry Kane, Dele Alli and Son Heung-min at Tottenham Hotspur. Cole Palmer also played some of his best football under Pochettino at Chelsea. United clearly have a lot of raw potential in their squad, with the likes of Amad , Leny Yoro and Ayden Heaven, but these players need serious guidance if they are ever going to get close to fulfilling their potential. In addition, the head coach is not a manager who will demand a huge budget or ready-made players to win. The coach will likely be more content to work within the unfortunate constraints under which owners such as the Glazers and INEOS operate. Some fans have called for serial winners such as Antonio Conte or a dream target such as Luis Enrique, but the reality is that United do not have the playing quality or financial capacity to fulfil the needs of managers like this. Pochettino will gladly try to improve what he has with some well-chosen additions and help guide United back into being a consistent team that can challenge at the top of the table. 270ab1ecd9138dee.title: Mauricio Pochettino: why the newly appointed Man United manager will take this star to the stratosphere
270ab1ecd9138dee.text: Matheus Cunha could thrive under Mauricio Pochettino, with his pressing, movement and transition play suited to the new manager. The post Mauricio Pochettino: why the newly appointed Man United manager will take this star to the stratosphere appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
270ab1ecd9138dee.content: Manchester United have not made the best signings in recent years. Last summer was seen as an outlier, though, as all four players, Matheus Cunha , Bryan Mbeumo, Benjamin Sesko and Senne Lammens, all played key roles as United went from 15th to third in the league. This season has evidently been a disaster so far, as they sit 18th in the league in November, and Michael Carrick has paid for this start with his job. Matheus Cunha Whilst Cunha has not hit the heights of last season, he has still provided four goals and five assists in all competitions. This included a stunning brace to beat AS Roma in a magical night at Old Trafford in the Champions League earlier this month. Nonetheless, Cunha struggled under Carrick at times, playing as a number nine and being shunted out of his natural position to accommodate Marcus Rashford since his return this season. Mauricio Pochettino will love him Much has been made of incoming Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino’s admiration for Rashford , but he will arguably love Cunha’s profile more. Cunha will fit the Argentine’s tactics like a glove. According to Premier League analysis , Pochettino favours “a 4-2-3-1 system where wide attackers operate as roaming inside forwards rather than rigid touchline wingers. Starting on the left, Cunha can drift centrally into the pockets between midfield and defence while an overlapping full-back.” The Brazil international always looks more dangerous when he has licence to drift in and out and also drop into midfield, so this will be great news for him. In addition, players like Dele Alli and Cole Palmer, who like to operate in the half-spaces, have traditionally done well for Pochettino, so there is no reason to believe Cunha cannot also benefit. The former Tottenham Hotspur coach’s system also heavily relies on high pressing, and United are not a team full of natural pressers. Cunha, however, is great at pressing and harrying defenders into mistakes, and it seems natural that he would adapt well to Pochettino’s demands. What’s more, the head coach also likes to employ fast transitions in attack and, once again, Cunha has often hurt teams in England like this for Wolverhampton Wanderers and United. Finally, the head coach is renowned for his ability to man-manage and forge strong relationships with players. Therefore, he may just be the man to get the occasionally erratic Cunha to click, feel loved and stay on task. 5a886f98e8350515.title: "She's so good on the ball": Eva Olid lavishes praise on surprise player ahead of Crystal Palace match
5a886f98e8350515.text: Eva Olid discusses Hanna Lundkvist, Scarlett Hill's injury and Manchester United Women's WSL meeting with Crystal Palace. The post “She’s so good on the ball”: Eva Olid lavishes praise on surprise player ahead of Crystal Palace match appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
5a886f98e8350515.content: Manchester United Women manager Eva Olid has been speaking to the media ahead of her side’s home match in the Women’s Super League (WSL) against Crystal Palace. Squad updates Olid admitted she was still waiting for physio reports, but the only player definitely out is Scarlett Hill , who will be out of action for weeks. Hanna Lundkvist form The Catalan coach praised her side’s tactical performance versus Aston Villa last weekend and singled out the Swedish international Lundkvist for special praise. Olid explained, “I think she’s a player who can play in different positions. She can play as a full-back, a wing-back or a wide centre-back. With the national team, she’s also playing as a number six.” She continued, “she’s so good on the ball. She’s a player who can come inside and can play out wide. As a manager, you always like having those kinds of players because you know they’re versatile and can play in different positions, giving different things to the team.” Crystal Palace threat Explaining the type of threat Palace will pose, she asserted, “I expect a very competitive match. They’ve been having good matches, especially their last result against Tottenham on Wednesday. It was a very competitive match, and they could have won the game.” Olid continued, “for that reason, I expect a really good match, tactically and in terms of intensity. I hope everyone enjoys it.” Despite her side being on an 11-game unbeaten streak, Olid still wanted to focus on what her side needs to work on. She added, “I know it’s repetitive, but we’re still in a process. We know there are a lot of things we have to improve. For me, it’s so important that I can see the team gaining a lot of confidence on the ball and starting to connect with each other. That’s what we need. For me, that’s a big step from where we started the season to where we are now, particularly in terms of confidence on the ball and connections between the players.” Finally, she also warned her players that the longer their streak goes on, the harder it will be to maintain. She explained, “I think all teams are motivated when they play against Manchester United in general. But if they know that we haven’t lost in 11 games, I think that’s going to give the opposition even more motivation. We just have to stay focused and take it week by week. We need to try to win the next match independently of everything else. 7a56691a387dbf87.title: Altay Bayindir: Man United loanee finally makes long-awaited debut for Celta Vigo
7a56691a387dbf87.text: Altay Bayindir made his debut for Celta Vigo in a 5-0 Copa del Rey win over Salamanca, keeping a clean sheet after joining on loan from Manchester United. The post Altay Bayindir: Man United loanee finally makes long-awaited debut for Celta Vigo appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
7a56691a387dbf87.content: Altay Bayindir has made his long-awaited debut for Celta Vigo. Career The Turkey international goalkeeper Altay Bayindir joined Fenerbahçe in 2019 and stayed at the club for four years. He moved to Manchester United in 2023 but never nailed down a starting role. Bayindir managed just 17 appearances for the club and was never really considered to be the number one, losing his position to André Onana and later Senne Lammens. As a result, the decision was taken to loan him out to Spanish side Celta Vigo, but he had not played a match for his new side. The Turk has only played some matches with his national side, but he was left out of Turkey’s most recent squad for the Nations League fixtures. Celta Vigo chance The 28-year-old finally got a chance to impress against Salamanca in the first round of the Copa del Rey. The Galician side cruised to a 5-0 away victory, as Bayindir had very little to do while keeping his first clean sheet for the club. He was only forced into making one save in the match. His penalty box was a vacuum in terms of action, as he was not required to make any high claims or punches to alleviate pressure on his underworked defence. Bayindir completed 72% of his passes in the match but just 42% of his long balls, suggesting that his passing was a little out of practice. He was also not forced to win any duels as his Celta Vigo career finally got off to a running start. The Spanish side have an interesting week ahead, with matches against Real Madrid and AFC Bournemouth. 7ce0c0627aebb4cb.title: “I’m very lucky”: Man United Women captain Maya Le Tissier delighted with incredible milestone
7ce0c0627aebb4cb.text: Manchester United Women captain Maya Le Tissier discusses reaching 150 appearances and the recovery routine behind her consistency. The post “I’m very lucky”: Man United Women captain Maya Le Tissier delighted with incredible milestone appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
7ce0c0627aebb4cb.content: Manchester United Women captain Maya Le Tissier continues to be a beacon of consistency for the club. She has just won the Player of the Month award for October. She is also closing in on her 150th appearance for the club when she plays against Crystal Palace later today. Talking to the club media , she opened up on this milestone. She explained: “it’s amazing, to play 150 times for United is a dream and I’m very lucky to be able to do that.” Le Tissier continued, “I don’t think there are many players that have had the dream to play for United, let alone 150 times, so it will be a very special day.” The England defender has an impressive ability to stay fit and play regularly. When asked how she manages it, she explained: “I think when you play two or three games a week, you have to recover fast. The game’s growing at such a high pace and a high level now that if you’re not recovering right and you’re not up to standards, you’re going to get found out in games.” Going into more detail about her routine, she explained: “I think we have an amazing nutritionist here, Hanna, who sorts us out all the time. As soon as I go in, I have my protein shake and have a cherry juice, which I usually take home with me. I get in the ice bath, which is not that nice, but I enjoy it sometimes, a bit of pain! That’s mainly what I do.” Le Tissier also said that nutrition and hydration are vital and that fuelling up for games is essential. The club reported that only Leah Galton, Ella Toone, Millie Turner and Katie Zelem have played 150 or more times for the club, and Le Tissier is very proud to become part of that elite group. She asserted, “[They’ve been] really important. Every single one of them were there when I first came in and joined the team, and they were all amazing with me.” Commenting on her current teammate, Toone, she said: “Tooney being here now, she’s an incredible person, incredible player. She’s been here for such a long time now that she knows the standards, she lives the standards, and the amount of passion she plays with as well. She’s obviously a real Manc, and she’s such an amazing person to have around the team as well.” Maya Le Tissier Season 26/27 Stat Maya Le Tissier · FA WSL M. 3051df00282e90ca.content: Manchester United’s summer midfield rebuild has not unravelled as expected. Tasked with filling the big boots of the outgoing Casemiro , INEOS invested over £150 million in three players. In came Chelsea midfielder Andrey Santos, Aston Villa’s Youri Tielemans and Brighton & Hove Albion star Carlos Baleba. The trio, along with the highly talented Kobbie Mainoo, were expected to push the Red Devils into a higher gear following a third-placed finish last season. Unfortunately, the English giants are now 18th in the Premier League table, with just one league win to their name so far. All three new signings have failed to deliver, prompting talk of further reinforcements in 2027. United reportedly scouted several candidates for the midfield position this summer, including Youssouf Fofana , who ended up joining Sevilla on loan on transfer deadline day. Primarily a defensive midfielder, the Frenchman is also comfortable in an attacking role. The 27-year-old’s aggressive pressing, ball-winning abilities and elite engine make him a good fit for Mauricio Pochettino’s high-intensity tactical system. The Argentine manager, who will take charge at Old Trafford next week as Michael Carrick’s replacement, could demand an upgrade on the midfielders at his disposal in 2027. It now appears, according to reports, that INEOS are ready to rekindle their interest in Fofan a but will face stiff competition for his signature. United battling Tottenham Hotspur and Juventus for Youssouf Fofana According to Calciomercato , United are battling Tottenham Hotspur and Juventus for the services of Fofana in the summer of 2027. While Sevilla will hope to retain the Frenchman, all three of his suitors have already taken preliminary steps to win the race. The report states: “Sevilla will give it a go, but will have to be wary of fierce competition from clubs such as Tottenham, Manchester United and Juventus, who have already begun to take the first steps and make initial exploratory enquiries to gauge the terms of a transfer next summer.” The report, however, insists that a move is not possible in the winter as there is no break clause in the deal, citing Sevilla sporting director José Ignacio Navarro, who said in a recent interview: “Youssouf hasn’t played well in recent matches.” “He hasn’t played well, but neither has any other player in the team. His contract with us, however, runs until 30 June and, as things stand, there are no plans to terminate the loan. We’re confident he’ll see out the season with Sevilla.” Transfer fee could work in United’s favour The report also suggests that the transfer fee involved could make it harder for Sevilla to retain their star man. AC Milan are reportedly ready to let Fofana leave next summer for just €15 million (£12.5 million), which should not be a problem for United. The report says the Frenchman currently earns €5.55 million (£4.63 million) gross per year, which could also be an issue for the La Liga giants, but not for his Premier League suitors. d14c7d3f92b56f30.content: Manchester United are entering another new era, having replaced Michael Carrick with Mauricio Pochettino. Pochettino left the USMNT to manage United, a club he had apparently been hoping to lead since his time at Tottenham Hotspur. The Argentinian tactician has made his name with his high-intensity, attacking style of football. He also earned praise for developing young players in north London. Manchester United land Tyler Adjei Mauricio Pochettino gave more debuts (12) to players aged 21 or under than any other Premier League manager during his time at Tottenham Hotspur. As such, the Argentine may relish the opportunity to work with Manchester United’s academy, as INEOS have invested heavily in it over the last two years. They have also snapped up another exciting talent in recent days. According to Fabrizio Romano , Manchester United have completed a deal to sign Tyler Adjei from Reading. The Italian journalist posted an edited image of the youngster in a United shirt with his trademark statement, “Here We Go”, on it. “All done for 16-year-old to join #mufc project,” his post read. “Talented forward has accepted all terms, deal in place.” “Documents to be approved next week,” he added. Manchester United complete deal to sign Tyler Adjei from Reading — all done for 16 year old to join #mufc project. Talented forward has accepted all terms, deal in place — as @AndyMitten reported. Documents to be approved next week. pic.twitter.com/QwUQrvLVHD — Fabrizio Romano (@FabrizioRomano) November 14, 2026 Who is Tyler Adjei? Adjei is the first signing of the Mauricio Pochettino era, but he will initially be part of United’s under-18s, managed by Darren Fletcher . Born in England, Adjei is of Ghanaian descent. The highly-rated England youth international is primarily a number nine, but he can operate anywhere across the front three. He moves to United after making 19 appearances for Reading’s under-18s, scoring five goals in the process. “He’s got an athletic profile; he’s got more to come physically,” a source told The Athletic . “He moves well; he has a good temperament, mentality and demeanour. He has a good energy to train. He’s got a way to go technically, as is the norm for a player of his age.” Featured image by Molly Darlington via Getty Images online polls The post Tyler Adjei: Fabrizio Romano confirms United have completed deal to sign striker for academy appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .

076ace1ca84d3ac2.title: Surprise stats suggest Man United’s crucial summer decision is the root of all their struggles - The Athletic
076ace1ca84d3ac2.text: Stats explain how Manchester United's midfield and set-piece output have declined following Casemiro's departure from this summer. The post Surprise stats outline how Man United have missed Casemiro this season appeared first on Man United News And Transfer News | The Peoples Person .
076ace1ca84d3ac2.content: Former Manchester United midfielder Casemiro was in sizzling form last season, but it was not enough to convince INEOS to offer him a new deal. The Brazilian was also linked with an exit in the summer of 2025, but ended up staying and delivered a campaign to remember at Old Trafford. The Brazilian finished the season with nine goals and two assists from 35 games. He forged a stellar partnership with Kobbie Mainoo in the second half of the campaign and helped the Red Devils finish third in the Premier League. Unfortunately, with the 34-year-old on the wrong side of 30 and on exorbitant wages at the Theatre of Dreams, the English giants opted to let him go when his contract expired this summer. Casemiro opted to move to Inter Miami, but United’s efforts to fill his shoes at Old Trafford have not gone according to plan so far. United’s midfield revamp has been a disappointment United ended the summer with the purchases of Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans and Carlos Baleba, all candidates with Premier League experience who were expected to hit the ground running at Old Trafford. Unfortunately, the Red Devils have still missed Casemiro this season, with none of the trio managing to replicate his performances in midfield. The English giants have lacked the Brazilian’s instinct for snuffing out danger and protecting the defensive line, as evidenced by the fact that they have conceded 30 goals in 15 games! However, United appear to have missed Casemiro most in the final third, as outlined by a report. Tielemans Yellow cards 11 3 1 1 Red cards 1 0 0 0 Page 3 of 3 1 2 3 United have missed Casemiro at set-pieces According to The Athletic , Casemiro’s absence has severely hurt United during set-pieces this season. The report states: “The major statistical detail that stands out, however, is United completely losing their set-piece threat (down from 98 to nine in this ranking system).” “The metric is calculated by expected goals (xG) at set pieces plus goals per 100 set pieces, but weighted 70:30 in favour of xG to reward teams who are generating chances from them but aren’t necessarily scoring.” “A large chunk of United’s drop-off can be traced back to Casemiro. He scored eight goals from set pieces last season – no other player in the squad managed more than two – while he was responsible for around 27 per cent of United’s xG generated from corners.” Casemiro forged a telepathic understanding with Bruno Fernandes, especially at set-pieces, which served United very well. United have underestimated the cost of Casemiro’s departure The report goes on to state that while a departure was always expected due to the finances involved, United may have underestimated the performance cost of Casemiro’s exit. It continues: “Aged 34 and on wages of around £300,000 per week, Casemiro was destined to leave United under the INEOS regime, but the performance cost of his departure has been underappreciated.” “He would at times vacate space in the centre of the pitch in search of being effective in the final third, but often his instinct was right, and United have not replaced that roaming, goalscoring presence in any of their three midfield signings.” United’s failure to properly replace Casemiro also paints a poor picture of the club’s recruitment. With Mauricio Pochettino taking charge as Carrick’s replacement, the Red Devils have to perform better in the transfer market if they want the Argentine to get them out of troubled waters. e303832763673f36.content: A new study has concluded what many of us already knew – that Manchester United fans are the best in England. United currently dwell in 18th place in the actual Premier League table after another dismal start to the season on the pitch. But the Football Fandom Index , compiled by researchers at kwiff, has the Red Devils comfortably in first place. The index ranked all 20 Premier League clubs, plus the 24 teams currently in the Championship, based on the passion and dedication of their supporters. One of the factors used to determine the strength of connection between a club and its fans was the number of stadium sellouts they had delivered over the last decade. The number of murals, statues, monuments, club-affiliated venues and street names related to a club in its local area was also considered, while each club’s matchday traditions were also taken into account. (Photo by Molly Darlington/Getty Images) A total of eight criteria were used, with each club then receiving an overall score out of 100. The Red Devils ended up with 63/100, which left them seven points clear of Arsenal in second place. Liverpool were down in third, with Chelsea, Everton, Manchester City, Newcastle and Leeds completing the top eight. The highest-ranked club outside the Premier League was Derby County in ninth. At the other end of the table, the lowest-ranked Premier League fanbase was Brentford, with a score of just 14. Crystal Palace, Hull City and Aston Villa also found themselves below many Championship clubs, while Tottenham Hotspur were only 23rd. Check out the rankings in full below. 5b6883698242341c.content: Bournemouth starlet Rayan has revealed that he has ‘always’ been a Manchester United fan. The 20-year-old has been taking the Premier League by storm since joining the Cherries from Vasco da Gama in January. What did Rayan have to say about MUFC? In a recent interview, Rayan explained (via Standard Sport): “I’ve always supported Manchester United here in England “Why United? Because of Cristiano Ronaldo. Old Trafford was a dream of mine to play at. It was a dream come true.” The admission will certainly intrigue INEOS chiefs, as United have already been linked with a potential move for the Brazilian in recent months. Although he has only made 31 appearances across all competitions for Bournemouth, Rayan has shown enough to indicate he’s one of the new hottest prospects in Europe. How Rayan has been faring in England He has returned 10 goals and two assists in 2,194 minutes of action. The United faithful may be particularly familiar with his capabilities, given he was on the scoresheet when Bournemouth clinched a 3-0 league victory at Old Trafford back on October 25. In regard to Rayan’s position, the vast majority of his outings have come on the right wing, though he has also been deployed on the left flank and centrally. Bolstering the frontline in M16 isn’t seen as much of a priority as the defence is in 2027, but reinforcements will be essential if new manager Mauricio Pochettino is to have any chance of succeeding with his squad. Marcus Rashford and Amad Diallo have yet to find the back of the net this season, while centre-forward Benjamin Sesko is proving to be concerningly injury-prone, having been out of action since the Carabao Cup defeat to Brighton and Hove Albion on September 16. Presumably, Bournemouth will be doing their utmost to ensure Rayan stays put at the Vitality Stadium, where he is contracted to until June 2031. 332dd3a03ac7605f.content: What AFC Bournemouth’s Rayan has just confessed about the Cherries’ 3-0 win over Manchester United should set alarm bells ringing at Old Trafford. Last month, the Cherries travelled to Manchester and outwitted Michael Carrick ’s side, a statement victory that added to the misery of the embattled former United head coach. Weeks later, that win is still being discussed. In an interview alongside clubmate Evanilson for ESPN Brazil , as transcribed by Sport Witness , Rayan was asked how it felt to beat United. Rayan’s Manchester United confession He replied while making some interesting confessions: “Yeah, it’s true, that’s exactly how it feels. I was even talking to the people at home, my wife and the people who are with me, and I told them I’ve always supported Manchester United here in England.” The interviewer then asked whether, while still a Bournemouth player, he continues to follow United. “Yes, really,” he answered. When pressed on why, he added: “Because of Cristiano Ronaldo.” Rayan could have been a Manchester United player Hearing Rayan say this, and remembering that United could reportedly have signed him last winter ahead of Bournemouth, will frustrate Old Trafford supporters. But what has frustrated them further is how quickly he adapted to the Premier League. Rayan Premier League stats Stat 2025/26 · Bournemouth 2026/27 · Bournemouth Season 2025/26 2026/27 Club Bournemouth Bournemouth Apps 15 10 Starts 13 10 Minutes 1119 880 Goals 5 1 Assists 2 0 Shots 17 22 Shots on target 8 10 Key passes 14 8 Tackles 11 14 Interceptions 8 9 Updated 14 Nov 2026 He arrived and immediately transferred his Vasco da Gama goalscoring form, finding the net five times in his first 15 games while providing two assists. His bright start prompted leading outlets to produce detailed analysis of his quality. The Athletic labelled him “already one of the Premier League’s most fearsome attackers”. The piece highlighted how perfectly he filled the void left by Antoine Semenyo, noting how decisive the now Manchester City forward had been for the Cherries. Big transfer boost All of this gives United perfect motivation to bring Rayan to Old Trafford. Should they find themselves in a race for his signature, he is likely to lean towards a move to M16. Favouring a switch to Manchester is one thing, however; meeting Bournemouth’s hefty asking price is quite another. The versatile Bournemouth star reportedly carries a £130 million release clause in his deal at the Vitality Stadium.
